20010101.desc: A slime that has undergone ecological changes due to abundant Dendro in its environment.\nIt has also taken on the weaknesses of the Dendro element, and will burn intensely the moment it meets a bright flame.

20010201.desc: A slime that has undergone ecological changes due to abundant Dendro in its environment.\nThere are some who see it as something similar to the Whopperflowers, hiding its true form to trick and hunt its prey, and some regard it as a slime that has been parasitized by some special plant. From this point of view, might some cultures also see these slimes as having some special medicinal value?

20010301.desc: A small monster created by the coalescing of Anemo dispersed throughout nature.\nIt is able to float in the air to a certain degree due to the power of Anemo.

20010401.desc: A monster created by the coalescing of Anemo dispersed throughout nature.\nOwing to being comprised of a greater concentration of Anemo, their flotation abilities are stronger than that of Anemo Slimes. The hilichurls living out in the wilds have made use of this special characteristic, creating special vehicles that use Large Anemo Slimes as a form of locomotion to transport goods from unknown sources.

20010501.desc: A small monster created by the coalescing of Electro dispersed throughout nature.\nAccording to analyses, the jumping of Electro Slimes reflects the electric potential difference in the ground. In areas brimming over with Electro, their unusual movements can be observed and used to avoid danger.

20010601.desc: A monster created by the coalescing of Electro dispersed throughout nature.\nDue to the abundant Electro within its form, it will deliver an electric shock to its surroundings from time to time. At present, some have attempted to harness this energy to aid in production activities. Perhaps some new science will be born from this...?

20010701.desc: A monster created by the coalescing of Electro dispersed throughout nature.\nElectro Slimes can undergo mutations to become bright yellow. Due to the abundant Electro within its form, it will deliver an electric shock to its surroundings from time to time, and it can even cause nearby Electro Slimes to release electric arcs. This arc lightning will not bounce between purple Electro Slimes, which shows that Electro Slimes have two different polarities.\nOne wonders if some great new science could emerge from the study of such phenomena...

20010801.desc: A small monster created through the coagulation of Cryo in the natural environment.\nCompetitors once spread malicious rumors that the Dawn Winery used Cryo Slimes to control the temperature of their wine cellar and preserve the quality of their alcohol.

20010901.desc: A monster created through the coagulation of Cryo in the natural environment.\nThese slimes can use the abundant Cryo energies within themselves to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere and form a protective shell around themselves. They can also utilize a similar principle to freeze the water around them. On some level, this can be considered to be the freest species of slime, as it can cross oceans and seas with ease.

20011001.desc: A small monster created by the sedimentation of Hydro dispersed throughout nature.\nLegend has it that some people would use Hydro Slimes as an emergency water source, packing them in preparation for travels through dry regions or deep domains. But due to the high concentration of Hydro within these slimes, direct ingestion is, in fact, harmful to the human body.

20011101.desc: A monster created by the sedimentation of Hydro dispersed throughout nature.\nA larger and more powerful Hydro Slime that can create bubbles to entrap its enemies. It is said that they can grow to truly staggering sizes if given an energy-rich environment. Eyewitnesses have supposedly seen Hydro Slimes as large as a small mound in Wolvendom.

20011201.desc: A small monster created by the sedimentation of Pyro dispersed throughout nature.\nIts intelligence is very basic, but its uses are just as broad — well, for hilichurls, that is.

20011301.desc: A monster created by the sedimentation of Pyro dispersed throughout nature.\nThough its intelligence has not increased with its size, it is very hot. During dry seasons, it can cause wildfires. It will spit forth blazing fireballs when angered, and will turn dark when it is feeling down. A most expressive slime, indeed.

20011401.desc: Small monsters created through the buildup of Geo within the earth.\nGenerally speaking, the crust of the earth is filled with Geo energy. Geo Slimes that are formed this way have a similarly "down-to-earth" sort of feeling.

20011501.desc: Monsters created through the buildup of Geo within the earth.\nThey can harden the energy within their bodies into a carapace of stone that protects them and prevents damage. The legend of a "Golden Geo Slime King" once circulated among the Treasure Hoarders. They believed that since gemstones and ores have Geo energy in them, Geo Slimes, which also contain Geo energy, may also be a type of gemstone or ore.

20020101.desc: The corporeal form of extremely high-quality Anemo energies.\nThe formation of an Eye of the Storm indicates that the elemental ley lines of a region are blocked, which has led to siltation. Its reckless, heedless wielding of storms that all but sweeps people off their feet may be due to its nature as a symbol of the world stricken by malaise.

20040101.desc: Code name: Aleph. A high-purity Electro entity.\nElemental hypostases are the highest forms of elemental structures, usually formed either at a location bursting with elemental energy or at a clogged ley line.\nElemental hypostases have developed various attacks based on their elemental attributes.

20040201.desc: Code name: Beth. A high-purity Anemo entity.\nElemental hypostases are life forms which have completely abandoned their former appearance and biological structure, making them able to reach the highest level of elemental purity.\nResearch into hypostases is mainly led by scholars of Sumeru Akademiya, but due to the level of danger that they pose, little of substance is known about hypostases beyond their scientific name and code name.

20040301.desc: Code name: Gimel. A high-purity Geo entity.\nElemental hypostases are ultra-compact structures with a high mass.\nConcentrated elemental energy forms a solid shell around the core of the hypostasis, leaving only the core reactive to elemental stimuli.

20040401.desc: Code Name: He. A high-purity Hydro entity.\nHypostases have strong rejection properties, and will mercilessly expel any that test them.\nIts rejection behavior even extends to natural elements.

20040501.desc: Code name: Daleth. A high-purity Cryo entity.\nResearch suggests that there are subtle differences between elemental hypostases and other elemental life forms in terms of their physical composition. Perhaps these differences can account for their high level of homeostasis and their almost mechanical movements.

20040601.desc: Code Name: Ayin. A high-purity Pyro entity.\nAccording to researchers, Elemental Hypostases are related to anomalies in local Elemental veins. But whether it is the existence of Elemental Hypostases that have affected Elemental veins or the mutated Elemental Energy that created Elemental Hypostases remains to be confirmed.

20040701.desc: Code Name: Zayin. A high-purity Dendro entity.\nAccording to the deductions of some researchers, Elemental Hypostases have the knowledge required to "learn," which is how they use "mimesis" to initiate attacks. However, the ability to incorporate information to create change also opens one to the risk of information contamination. As this creature learns and changes, the purpose of its birth — no matter how academically unquantifiable it may still be — may yet become so distorted as to be rendered irrelevant.

20050101.desc: A life-form created from condensed Hydro elements of incredible purity. Often attached to bodies of water.\nIt is said that as water bodies become purer, the Hydro elements within grow more abundant, causing the Oceanids to grow more powerful. It is also said by some that Oceanids were once sea creatures from a home far away who carried the fragments of a long-dead god to the many corners of this world. Perhaps they did this so that the love their god held for this world could be spread through the waters to all the land...

20051001.desc: Today, with the Oceanids extirpated from Fontaine, strange elemental life forms have appeared in the waters.\nThe elemental spirits that appeared after the calamity lack the elegance and beauty of the Oceanids, and thus have been called "tainted." Though the toxins dissolved in the water have long since been diluted and cleansed, unless there are still containers of pure water somewhere, Fontaine's waters will never again naturally birth Oceanids.

20051101.desc: Today, with the Oceanids extirpated from Fontaine, strange elemental life forms have appeared in the waters.\nIt is said that in Egeria's era, the Oceanids often lived alongside humans, and lived in the springs of clear waters dotted across the lands, and through this, they connected the waters of the world. But most died with their god, and for the survivors, the world no longer has any god they recognize.

20051201.desc: A humanoid monster formed from the agglomeration of water.

20060101.desc: A monster birthed from a high concentration of Hydro that can float in the air.\nOn moonlit nights, Hydro Specters will give off a ghostly glow as they float by the riverbank. Their furtive forms are often mistaken by passers-by for wandering spirits, which has made them mainstays in quite a few folktales.

20060201.desc: A monster birthed from a high concentration of Geo that can float in the air.\nGeo Specters mimic the fruit of certain plants when their wings are closed together. As such, they are held by some ancient tales to be the fruit of a giant tree in the sky, and are regarded as having mysterious medical value.

20060301.desc: A monster birthed from a high concentration of Anemo that can float in the air.\nAs reason might dictate, monsters made from coalesced Anemo already come equipped with the ability to float. As such, their petal-like wings are most likely to be a mimetic organ first and foremost.

20060401.desc: A monster born from highly-concentrated Cryo elements that can float in the air.\nA certain alchemist once studied these beings, speculating that they might be a kind of Slime or the Traveler, as none of the above needed a Vision to use the elements. He was reprimanded by his teacher.

20060501.desc: A monster born from highly-concentrated Electro elements that can float in the air.\nA certain researcher once studied these creatures. He believed that they must be Hypostases of some kind. After all, they both had elemental peculiarities and were birthed from areas saturated with elemental energy, right? By the way, he was later investigated for academic corruption.

20060601.desc: A monster born from highly-concentrated Pyro elements that can float in the air.\nThere was once an Akademiya student who conducted research into their behavior. He believed that Specters were a form of Crystalfly; since they both had powers of flight and both were birthed in areas saturated with elemental energy. He has not graduated yet.

20060701.desc: A monster born from high-density Dendro energy that can float in the air.\nA researcher from Vahumana once did research into the ecological peculiarities of Dendro Specters, finding them to be quite similar to the legendary "Aranara." His conclusion was that the Aranara were actually Dendro Specters. This researcher would become a little-known writer of fairy tales.

20070101.desc: An abnormal Electro elemental life form. Although it might appear similar to an Oceanid, it does not possess her intelligence or memories.\nThat which drives the Thunder Manifestation is a much more primal fury.\nIt is said that these life forms will only descend like lightning upon places that play host to great lingering resentment, such as the fragmented Amakumo Peak, where the storm clouds ever roil. As long as the grudges of the land do not fade, so will the roaring thunder persist.

20080101.desc: An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Electro, resulting in its present form.\nOne of the manifestations with the most violent temperament, it commands steel-shattering bolts of lightning like mere servants, such that any land it passes through shall be marked as if by a marauding, thunderous calamity.\nIn still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

20080201.desc: An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Dendro, resulting in its present form.\nThis entity has a marvelous resonance with the plant life of the groves. Some say that one of the Moonchanters once made a contract with the wooded lands with their help, thus becoming a friend and companion to all life on this land.\nIn still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

20080301.desc: An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Pyro, resulting in its present form.\nOne of the manifestations with the most violent temperament, even at the frigid edges of the world, it is wreathed in unquenchable flame.\nIn still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

20080401.desc: An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Cryo, resulting in its present form.\nIt is said that this entity is closest to the original form of a Frostnight Scion. It will use icy mists and crystals to set up redoubtable walls, but perhaps it does this only to separate the flawless primeval light from the world that lies beneath the moon.\nIn still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

20080501.desc: An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Hydro, resulting in its present form.\nIts clear, glass-like body is composed almost entirely of the purest water droplets. Though gentler than most of its kin, once provoked it can instantly shape the surrounding water into razor-sharp blades capable of piercing any unwary intruder's defenses.\nIn still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

20080601.desc: An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Anemo, resulting in its present form.\nThe flowing wind has spun an extra pair of wings for it. As it almost never leaves footprints on the ground, it's also known as the one who walks with the wind.\nIn still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

20080701.desc: An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Geo, resulting in its present form.\nJust about its entire body is covered by the accumulated Geo, while its tough antlers gleam with the luster of polished amber.\nIn still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

20081001.desc: Proud beings that roam in the waning glow of the moon, wielding ancient powers long since tamed by the Lord of the Sky.\nLegends say these graceful, mystical beasts were born in the age when the Frost Moon still turned, and, favored by the divine emissary, they would not be tainted by the light of day. Even now, among the followers of the Frost Moon, they are regarded as sacred beasts lost to this world, retreating along secret lunar paths beyond the reach of mortal eyes. Yet, as they have for countless centuries past, they still wander in the shadows of the moon, treading the boundary between two worlds, guarding the lands coveted by calamity, and watching over those who dwell within them — for this is the very oath they first swore to the apostle of the golden city.

21010101.desc: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.\nThey look very similar to humanity but seem to have lost both their intellect and spirituality. Their presence on the continent has been recorded for over a thousand years, and yet they have neither history nor civilization.\nSince the pitch-black calamity from five hundred years ago, they have begun to spread in large numbers across the land. They are not very strong, and they lack organization, but they nonetheless bring sizable trouble to humans every once in a while.

21010201.desc: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.\nIll-tempered warriors for their tribes, they are simple-minded believers in the power of brute force. If their muscles grow strong enough and their strength great enough, then one day they too shall raise up a great shield and become a mitachurl... Or will they?

21010301.desc: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.\nHilichurl warriors who have wooden shields. These shields are not only sturdy defensive tools but also treasured items within the tribe. According to many reports, hilichurls will often charge at travelers making camp to cook and will snatch their pot lids after chasing them away.

21010401.desc: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.\nHilichurl Shooters who wield simple crossbows. Hilichurls do not, in truth, possess the craftsmanship needed to build crossbows. As such, it is commonly believed that there is an organization that controls the hilichurls from behind the scenes and furnishes them with equipment and material supplies. The Abyss Mages that often accompany these hilichurls are especially suspicious.

21010501.desc: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.\nThese archers wield simple crossbows, and their arrowheads are coated with a thin layer of flammable material that can set their targets on fire. El Musk of the previous generation believed that this is an innovation by brighter hilichurls who wished to cook their game after hunting it.

21010601.desc: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.\nThese sneaky fellows are skilled in the use of Pyro Slimes, using them as weapons to attack intruders. Skilled grenadiers may be able to destroy four wooden dummies in a single throw.

21010701.desc: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.\nThese hilichurls wield flaming clubs and charge with reckless abandon to chase intruding adventurers off. Most wildfires in the grasslands or forests are not actually caused by a certain special Knight, but due to the actions of these hilichurls.

21010901.desc: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.\nThese archers wield simple crossbows, and unmelting ice shrouds their arrowheads. It is said that wounds caused by these arrowheads heal very slowly, as the cold will slow the circulation of blood.

21011001.desc: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.\nThese archers wield simple crossbows, and their arrowheads are crafted from carved Electro Crystals that will deliver an electric shock upon impact. They say that Hilichurl Shooters of exceptional skill can fire five crossbow bolts at once — a most impressive feat indeed.

21011201.desc: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.\nHardy hilichurls who have congregated in a region where Geo energies are abundant. Their impregnable shields have layers of rocky growths on them.

21011301.desc: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.\nHilichurls have discovered the use of Cryo Slimes in effectively keeping food fresh. Hilichurls have surprising amounts of wisdom in the practical use of Slimes, whether it be the use of Pyro and Cryo Slimes to make Exploding Barrels, or the use of Anemo Slimes in vehicles... Perhaps this is their way of adapting to their hard lot in life.

21011401.desc: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.\nHilichurls display a strong sense of adaptability to their surroundings. In icy environments, they come up with ways and means to fashion this hard ice into shields to protect themselves.

21011501.ja: 変わったヒルチャール

21011601.desc: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.\nElectro Slimes don't seem to have as many applications as Pyro Slimes or Anemo Slimes in the benighted lives of the Hilichurls. Perhaps one day they may discover the flow of Elements between Electro Slime and Mutant Electro Slime and make some great progress... ?

21020101.desc: A muscular hilichurl who has been forged in countless fights.\nThey know how to use Dendro Slimes to create tough shields which they wield in combat.\nWith their powerful muscles, glossy fur, and sturdy, reliable silhouettes, they help the hilichurls withstand the pitiless assaults of adventurers, and they hold a rather exalted rank amongst the tribes.
21020101.ja: ヒルチャール暴徒·木盾

21020201.desc: Muscular hilichurls who wield large two-handed axes.\nAttacks with large strikes, and will use Pyro Slimes to infuse their axes with Pyro. They are very lethal.\nUsually, repeatedly quenching a weapon the way a Blazing Axe Mitachurl does will decrease the hardness of the metal and cause the axe-head's edge to chip more easily. But such is the strength of the mitachurls that even should the edge disappear altogether, they can still use their axes as hammers.
21020201.ja: ヒルチャール暴徒·炎斧

21020301.desc: A muscular hilichurl that uses a rock as a shield.\nFighting and eating meat are the two most important things to hilichurls, because those are what make them grow stronger.\nAll young hilichurls dream of growing up to become a big and strong mitachurl, because that way they can eat more meat, fight more battles, and wield those (almost) impregnable giant rock shields.
21020301.ja: ヒルチャール暴徒·岩盾

21020401.desc: A mysterious "lord" of hilichurls that stalks the snow and fog.\nThis huge hilichurl is referred to as a "lawa" by its brethren. Its body, honed to the very limit, almost seems to blend into its Cryo-filled environment, and its stoic nobility is like that of the frozen northland rivers.
21020401.ja: ヒルチャール·霜鎧の王

21020501.desc: A mysterious "lord" of hilichurls that walks between a thousand peaks.\nThis huge hilichurl is referred to as a "lawa" by its brethren. The abundant Geo energies in the environment have become part of their flesh, blood, and skin, which look as if they were chiseled out of mountain rock.
21020501.ja: ヒルチャール·岩兜の王

21020601.desc: A muscular hilichurl that uses solid ice as a shield, wielding it in battle.\nReason normally dictates that large creatures that see a lot of action should burn through a great number of calories to sustain themselves. As such, the present-day El Musk has proposed the "Mitachurl Index." This index correlates the percentage of mitachurls within the hilichurl population to the stability and success of hilichurl foraging activity.
21020601.ja: ヒルチャール暴徒·氷盾

21020701.desc: Muscular hilichurls who wield large, two-handed axes.\nAttacks with large strikes and uses Electro Slimes to infuse their axes with Electro. Their blows are very lethal.\nAxes forged from steel are highly conductive material. The image of those tall and strong Crackling Axe Mitachurls holding their axes up to summon lightning is quite majestic to the hilichurls.
21020701.ja: ヒルチャール暴徒·雷斧

21020801.desc: A mysterious "lord" of hilichurls that strides through the thunderstorm.\nThis huge hilichurl is referred to as "Lawa" by its brethren. Its giant body is so saturated with Electro energy that Elemental Energy seeps through the cracks in its body in the form of Electro Crystal growths.
21020801.ja: ヒルチャール·雷兜の王

21030101.desc: A wizened, mumbling hilichurl, one that chants of the power of Hydro.\nHilichurls especially gifted in commanding the elements who often reach the zenith of their skill in their twilight years. What sort of life would lead to such simple creatures being able to summon water and rains?
21030101.ja: ヒルチャールシャーマン·水

21030201.desc: A wizened, mumbling hilichurl, one that awakens the might of Dendro.\nHilichurls especially gifted in commanding the elements who often reach the zenith of their skill in their twilight years. A grudge stirs beneath that mask, and poison ivy sprouts as hateful whispers issue forth from it.
21030201.ja: ヒルチャールシャーマン·草

21030301.desc: A wizened, mumbling hilichurl, one that spreads the message of Anemo.\nHilichurls especially gifted in commanding the elements who often reach the zenith of their skill in their twilight years. Their ability to command the flowing winds stems from dark, forgotten memories.
21030301.ja: ヒルチャールシャーマン·風

21030401.desc: A wizened, mumbling hilichurl, one that listens to the strength of Geo.\nHilichurls especially gifted in commanding the elements who often reach the zenith of their skill in their twilight years. To the persevering mountains, these old hilichurls are but children, but their memories and experiences have guided them towards gaining power over rock and stone.
21030401.ja: ヒルチャールシャーマン·岩

21030501.desc: A wizened, mumbling hilichurl, one that calls upon the bite of Cryo.\nHilichurls especially gifted in commanding the elements who often reach the zenith of their skill in their twilight years. These shamans remember the frosty chants and are even more skilled in the art of using them to entrap their foes.
21030501.ja: ヒルチャールシャーマン·氷

21030601.desc: A wizened, mumbling Hilichurl, one that prays to Electro.\nHilichurls especially gifted in commanding elements who often reach the zenith of their skill in their twilight years. Since they possess such advanced skill in creating electricity and summoning thunder, you may as well use the crackling sound to compose an elegy.
21030601.ja: ヒルチャールシャーマン·雷

21040101.desc: Hilichurl wanderers who do not belong to any hilichurl tribe. It almost seems as if they are searching for the fated genesis of their kind, seeking to uncover some bygone splendor that once belonged to their people.\nIf these monsters capable of only crude language and bereft of missing history could record their own epics and legends, the hilichurl wanderers would be the heroes in said tales.
21040101.ja: ヒルチャールレンジャー·風

21040201.desc: Hilichurl wanderers unaffiliated with any specific tribe. They can often be found roving the wilds as if in voluntary exile.\nThey may also lend their aid to other hilichurls or hilichurl tribes for various reasons and go their separate ways afterward. They seem to possess a higher level of intelligence than commonplace hilichurls.

22010101.desc: Abyss creatures who command the power of Pyro in battle.\nFor unknown reasons, Abyss Mages are able to communicate with the hilichurls, thus enabling them to manipulate their minds easily. They say that Abyss Mages utter a long-forgotten language from which they draw magical power.

22010201.desc: Abyss creatures that call upon Cryo in battle.\nThough they dabble with great power and can even create icicles by condensing and freezing water vapor in the atmosphere, their bodies are very vulnerable in and of themselves. Once their protective Ward has been broken, they are at your mercy.

22010301.desc: Abyss creatures that utilize Hydro energy in battle.\nStories circulate among adventurers that Abyss Mages are at the lowest rung of the Abyss Order's hierarchy and that they roam the various lands to scheme fell deeds of destruction. Though they also often make fun of these Abyss Mages, saying that the most harm they can do is to cause rheumatism or a common cold, their power is not to be underestimated.

22010401.desc: Abyss creatures that utilize Electro in battles.\nWhile studying at the Akademiya, researcher Alva Nikola once conducted a systematic study of the methods by which Electro Abyss Mages manipulate Electro and came up with a theoretical weapon known as the Nikola Coil. However, it has yet to be put into practice. Some say that his research materials were eaten during a fungal infestation.

22020101.desc: Servants of the Abyss Order that use Hydro in combat.\nThese silent figures are the vanguard of the Abyss, brandishing Tidal Blades that can engulf everything in an instant, crumpling armor and obliterating heretics. They shall bring preordained damnation upon the foolish masses.

22020201.desc: A monster from the Abyss Order that wields frigid, icy blades in battle.\nJust as there are saints who will spread and glorify the profound gospel, there are envoys who must correct any twisted strains and remove any dissonance.\nPeople often say that steel feels like ice as it pierces the body, but this dark frost is said to freeze even the soul.

22030101.desc: A monster who serves the Abyss Order and commands lightning while singing the praises of the darkness.\nThese are the evangelists and the scholars of the Abyss. Their violent lightning strikes the hearts of unbelievers with dark wisdom, warped by the shadowy depths of an eternal night, its violet glow proclaiming the existence of a great power that corrodes human intellect.

22030201.desc: Wielders of abyssal fire who pursue the meaning behind texts and scriptures. Is a member of the Abyss Order.\nThe surface people have a slightly distorted understanding of what their name means, calling them "Lectors," when their name can also mean "exegete." Reading the word of grace grants them great power.

22040101.desc: A beast with monstrous blood that is capable of eroding the boundaries of the world. "Gold" classified them as "Alfisol."\nThey follow the encroaching abyss to devour the elements. Fortunately, there are few of them left now in this world.

22040201.desc: A beast with monstrous blood that is capable of eroding the boundaries of the world. "Gold" classified them as "Alfisol."\nIn times long gone, when giant monstrous beasts descended, large swarms of these hounds would go before them to deliquesce the borders of the world and open the way.

22050101.desc: A beast with monstrous blood that is capable of eroding the boundaries of the world. They were created by "Gold."\nThey do display certain biological behaviors similar to those of real wolves. Perhaps they feel jealousy towards these their "next of kin," and dream of replacing them someday.

22050201.desc: A beast with monstrous blood that is capable of eroding the boundaries of the world. They were created by "Gold."\nOnce upon a time, they ran riot across the continent, but they went extinct for a time due to resistance and mass hunts. Recently, however, they have re-emerged. The pack of black wolves that now threaten Springvale and Wolvendom are such creatures.

22060101.desc: Hailing from a dark world, this ruler of the black wolves has the power to call upon its followers, its hidden claws, to dissolve space itself and forge a rift through which it may enter.\nThe Wolflord has no name, for it was but one of "Gold"'s unintentional creations, and that is precisely why it is obsessed with invading worlds that do not belong to it and making a name for itself.\nThat said, the wolf pack is far from unintelligent. After suffering a defeat in its previous invasion, a deserted island where no humans or protectors dwell has been selected for them to prepare for their lord's descent.

22070101.desc: A pitch-dark soldier. Once a proud warrior of an ancient underground nation, it has now lost any awareness of memory.\nBut even so, it holds the banner of the royal house aloft into battle. Though it has forgotten its comrades or any royal blessing they might have been given, it will never lay this banner down.

22070201.desc: A pitch-dark soldier. Once a proud warrior of an ancient underground nation, it no longer has any "intelligence" that it may still be called "human."\nYet the desire to destroy the foe and plunge into battle to defend others is etched into this empty suit of armor, even if no one remains to tell it where the enemy is or who or what exactly must be defended.

22070301.desc: A pitch-dark soldier. Once a proud warrior of an ancient underground nation, it is now nothing but a husk that only bears memories of battle.\nAll shall decay in the end, and this is all that is left of the Black Serpent Knights amidst the merciless march of their sins, curses, and time itself.

22080101.desc: A guard of some standing in the court, sundering the foes of the nation's rulers using a sword art known as "Truthseeker."\nThe Twilight Sword was once one of their number. That realm's glory has been extinguished, never again to be reclaimed.

22080201.desc: A guard of some standing in the court, sundering the foes of the nation's rulers using a sword art known as "Truthseeker."\nThough Truthseeker is, strictly speaking, a sword art, its teachings can also be used with various other weapons — and in the realm's darkest hour, those who had to protect their homeland had little room to be fussy anyway.

22100501.desc: A monster from the Abyss that wields multiple types of Elemental Power and has gained extra limbs from its "evolution." "The nature of the 'Abyss' is essentially irreconcilable with the elements. However, even the elements of gods can be entrapped and distorted before they are subsumed to become tools of the abyssal will. Just judging from outcomes and practical use, "Abyssal powers" seem little different from elemental items, from ones as paltry as the Treasure Hoarders' elemental containers to those as powerful as Visions..." —Notes left behind in Hangeh Afrasiyab by someone.

22110101.desc: A strange life form that mostly appears in Elynas.\nMelusines perceive Breacher Primuses as harmless creatures, and many even find them completely adorable.\nThe visual perception of Melusines is very different from humans.
22110101.ja: 大型瓦礫ブリーチャープリムス

22110201.desc: A strange life form that mostly appears in Elynas.\nReceives a powerful shock from encountering ousia or pneuma energy, and thus Breacher Primuses can be driven away using this relatively nonaggressive and noninvasive means.
22110201.ja: 瓦礫ブリーチャープリムス

22110301.desc: A strange life form that mostly appears in Elynas.\nThe nature of a Breacher Primus defies known categories: they are not animals, plants, Shroom-Kin, nor Elementals. The debate among scholars of Sumeru never formally reached a consensus on just what it is, until it was finally banned as a research topic. The reason is that based on the current system of knowledge, this problem is like "the definitions prescribed by language and the true nature of things," and it is impossible to have a meaningful, final answer.
22110301.ja: 大型狂蔓ブリーチャープリムス

22110401.desc: A strange life form that mostly appears in Elynas.\nIn Fontaine, the earliest recorded observations of a Breacher Primus appeared shortly after the cataclysm. Records from the time show instances of Breacher Primuses both attacking and protecting humans.
22110401.ja: 狂蔓ブリーチャープリムス

22120101.desc: Abyssal creatures with plant-like forms that have descended from a deep, dark, unfathomable, contorted otherworld.\nThese twisted monstrosities are capable of infiltrating deep down into the bowels of the earth, extracting memories to imitate and manipulate. Through this process of distorting the past's memories into more abstruse and sordid forms, they gradually draw closer to Irminsul's core, threatening to undermine its very existence.\nSome say that these aberrations work constantly to corrupt the many colors of light, leaving only pitch-black information in their stead. Such a hypothesis seems to be confirmed by the branches they extend outward, as if to pierce the void itself...
22120101.ja: 深遠なるミミックパピラ・I型

22120201.desc: Abyssal monsters that have descended to this world from the deep, dark depths of a twisted and alien world, they possess a plant-like appearance.\nIt is said that where the corrosive waves of the dark tide lap, such plant-like dark monsters will grow. But they only bear a superficial resemblance to plants, for it is a form they only adopted to get closer to the tree-like world, that they might extract the necessary concepts from it, and analyze and imitate them.\nSome raving lunatics who have lost their minds say that those things that extend out like leaves are actually the beginnings of gates to other worlds.
22120201.ja: 深遠なるミミックフローラ

22130001.desc: A ghoul that stalks the frozen wilderness when the pitch-dark mist rolls in. Their emergence presages worse calamities to come.\nAll who dwell beneath the moon set out on journeys with their own goals and wishes in mind, but not all such wishes receive favor. Spirits that cannot rest due to engendered resentment, partings with loved ones, or desires that go unfulfilled, if corrupted by the Abyss, may transform into ghouls, forever lost in the thick mists of the Wild Hunt.
22130001.ja: ワイルド・ワンダラー

22131001.desc: A ghoul that stalks the frozen wilderness when the pitch-dark mist rolls in. Their emergence presages worse calamities to come.\nMany great champions of a lost ancient kingdom lie buried beneath the frozen northlands. Though the remnants of the past have been long wiped clean, these noble spirits yet defend their golden homeland. Awakened by Abyssal taint, these warriors now see all who trespass as prey.
22131001.ja: ワイルド・マッドウォーリアー

22140101.desc: An Abyssal creature that slips through rifts in the hidden depths, crossing over from beyond this world.\nLong ago, an ancient philosopher described humans as "featherless bipeds," using that simple phrase to distinguish mankind from animals and assert human superiority. In some sense, these deathless wanderers of the silent cosmic void, scaled instead of feathered, and using their hooked beaks to draw in biomass from world to world, might actually also match that same simplistic definition of "human."

22150101.en: Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares
22150101.desc: An Abyssal creature that creeps through rifts in the hidden depths, quietly watching this world. Its eerie, faceless form is said to be nothing more than a projection, for its true body exists only as a formless mass of pure Abyssal energy.\nEven invaders who seek to claim this world must obey its rules to some extent. Unless the heavens split open and the earth's defenses collapse, these star-born outsiders can do little more than linger at the world's fringes, whispering their madness into this realm, their attempts to seep inside amounting to nothing... But how long can this stability and order truly last?

23010101.desc: A soldier encased within a Fatui war machine.\nArmed with equipment that can control the elements to a certain extent, their guns are capable of firing jets of frost.\nThough this may confer elemental power beyond the ken of ordinary humans, that power may yet come at a price...
23010101.zh: 愚人众先遣队·冰铳重卫士
23010101.ja: ファデュイ先遣隊·重衛士·氷銃

23010201.desc: A soldier encased within a Fatui war machine.\nArmed with equipment that can control the elements to a certain extent, their guns are capable of firing jets of water.\nThese skirmishers do not question if they shall live or die as they advance into nations far from home to complete reconnaissance missions and lay the groundwork for operations to come.
23010201.zh: 愚人众先遣队·水铳重卫士
23010201.ja: ファデュイ先遣隊·重衛士·水銃

23010301.desc: A sturdily-built skirmisher armed with an Electro-powered war-hammer.\nAs a Fatui soldier, one has access to munificent resources: salaries, armaments, and supplies.\nBut at the same time, it also means much time away from home and family and putting one's life in the hands of comrades one has never met.
23010301.zh: 愚人众先遣队·雷锤前锋军
23010301.ja: ファデュイ先遣隊·前鋒軍·雷ハンマー

23010401.desc: A skirmisher with the ability to generate a Geo Ward and defend their allies.\nUnlike the elite Mages and Agents, Fatui Skirmishers are soldiers of lesser individual might.\nTo complete their tasks and reduce losses in men and material, their tactics are thus more reliant on teamwork.
23010401.zh: 愚人众先遣队·岩使游击兵
23010401.ja: ファデュイ先遣隊·遊撃兵·岩使い

23010501.desc: A skirmisher armed with the ability to manipulate Anemo and heal their comrades.\nThey departed from their motherland and did so for its sake. They left their family, yet gained allies to stick through thick and thin with.\n—Perhaps such thoughts are what get them through the unscrupulous work that their missions entail.
23010501.zh: 愚人众先遣队·风拳前锋军
23010501.ja: ファデュイ先遣隊·前鋒軍·風拳

23010601.desc: A Fatui soldier who wields a flaming gun.\nSkirmisher weapons can control the elements to a certain extent, and their combat tactics utilize elemental reactions.\nTheir ordnance and knowledge of squad-based combat thus constitute no small threat in battle.
23010601.zh: 愚人众先遣队·火铳游击兵
23010601.ja: ファデュイ先遣隊·遊撃兵·炎銃

23020101.desc: A Fatui secret agent.\nThe duty of a Fatui agent is to settle debts — but not only those of a monetary or goods-in-kind nature.\nThey also ensure dues are paid when it comes to the principle of "an eye for an eye." If there is one thing the Fatui are not known for, it is leniency, and whoever dares to oppose them will invoke the full force of their wrath.
23020101.zh: 愚人众·火之债务处理人
23020101.ja: ファデュイ·デットエージェント·炎

23030101.desc: A Fatui mage who can command Electro Cicins in battle. Their origins and what they look like under that mask are both mysteries.\nSimilarly to the way that Electro Cicins go crazy for Mist Grass, Cicin Mages take great pleasure in toying with their prey.

23040101.desc: A Fatui mage who can command Cryo Cicins in battle. Their origins and what they look like under that mask are both mysteries.\nReason dictates that those who lack Visions should not be able to control the elements as these mages do. However, in addition to using Mist Grass to control the Cryo Cicins, they also boldly wield the might of frost. Seeing them as they wander the land in their seemingly aimless way, one can't help but wonder about the duty that must compel them...

23050101.desc: A Fatui mage who can command a Hydro Mirror in battle. Her posture is highly dignified, as if she is one who worships a god.\nThe Hydro Mirror she manipulates lures those enchanted by her to willingly fall for her illusion. Nothing seems to escape her ears. No one knows what those covered eyes have seen, nor what kind of obsession might be reflected in them...
23050101.ja: ファデュイ·ミラーメイデン

23060101.desc: An elite agent among the Fatui.\nSelected while still children, they can only become an "Operative" after many long years of training and teaching, after countless rounds have winnowed the field. They are the most outstanding soldiers among the Fatui, with extraordinary skill and unswerving loyalty.
23060101.ja: ファデュイ·氷霜の従者

23060201.desc: An elite agent among the Fatui.\n"Operatives" have no ordinary military rank among the Fatui. Based on their orders and the content of their missions, they can work in concert with other soldiers, work alone, or in tandem with the "tacks" hidden and scattered across the world. They spy, conduct counter-espionage, protect, assassinate, and conduct other tasks. In order to effectively carry out missions of a more special nature, "Operatives" also need to master all kinds of other skills and even various arts and talents.
23060201.ja: ファデュイ·烈風の従者

23070101.desc: A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a gunblade and tasked to hold the line as the resilient backbone of the Oprichniki forces.\nAccording to Snezhnayan infantry manuals, the primary duties of line troops are merely to aim, shoot, and charge. Even should the individual soldier's combat power not prove exceptional, soldiers of the line in tight formation remain a key foundation of the Snezhnayan military machine.
23070101.ja: ファデュイ特務隊・戦列兵

23072101.desc: A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a heavy shield and tasked to fight at the very front to protect their comrades.\nMany understand that in the long war between Snezhnaya and the dark calamity, only the side that holds out with greater resolution can outlast the other and emerge victorious. The ultimate resolution of the Oprichniki is, undoubtedly, the shield that protects their forces — so long as this shield does not fall, there is always hope for victory.
23072101.ja: ファデュイ特務隊・重撃兵

23073101.desc: A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a man-portable grenade launcher that can perform close-range bombardment.\nThough the Oprichniki has large-scale, fully-functional fire support attachments, the commanding staff still advocates for large numbers of grenadiers to be maintained. After all, no big gun can compare in surety at the very front lines of combat to a grenade launcher you can direct at will.
23073101.ja: ファデュイ特務隊・銃士

23074101.desc: A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with engineering tools and highly adept in close-range combat.\nTo meet the demands of battlefield operations, the Fatui Oprichniki established vanguard units, tasked with clearing the path of obstacles for advancing forces. As for exactly what counts as an obstacle, that hardly matters. Be it an impassable ravine or a formidable foe standing in their way, they will remove it without hesitation — whatever it takes to ensure the banner of the Pale Star marches on.
23074101.ja: ファデュイ特務隊・前衛

23076101.desc: A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a staff-like device and tasked with providing emergency medical support to their comrades in arms.\nIn truth, these medics have largely only taken crash-course training, and as such, their healing abilities are limited. In practice, they tend to adopt more efficient methods of supporting their allies — mixing in with the different units and charging at the enemy lines.
23076101.ja: ファデュイ特務隊・衛生兵

23078101.desc: A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a specialized hover pack and explosive charges, and tasked with performing breaching operations.\nAs troops with immense breakthrough potential, bombardiers are often sent to the most dire of battlefields, making them the troops who gain meritorious promotions most quickly. It is said that Oprichniki officers overwhelmingly come from the ranks of the bombardiers.
23078101.ja: ファデュイ特務隊・擲弾兵

23079101.desc: An elite officer of the Fatui Oprichniki who specializes in close combat using a giant blade.\nWhether it be in the war against the dark calamity or against those ignoramuses who dare stand against the Tsaritsa's ideals, those who breach at the tip of the spear suffer the greatest casualties. As such, those who survive multiple battles are naturally the elite of the elite. There will always be those willing to become the fire and sword of the empire, just as there will always be those who chafe against the injustice of fate and the inequity of the Old World.
23079101.zh: 愚人众特辖队·火刃突击队
23079101.ja: ファデュイ特務隊・突撃兵・ファイアーブレイド

23079201.desc: An elite officer of the Fatui Oprichniki who uses a heavy cannon to tear enemy formations apart while using a mighty shield to defend their comrades.\nBitter battles have dyed the shield frost white, while coatings of blood have tinted its edges black. Oprichniki officers know that empty words will never bring back those who have fallen in sacrifice — only a bombardment akin to a hailstorm can shake this defiled Old World.
23079201.zh: 愚人众特辖队·冰雹重炮手
23079201.ja: ファデュイ特務隊・重砲兵・ヘイルストーム

23079301.desc: An elite officer of the Fatui Oprichniki who specializes in using twin guns in combat.\nUnlike their Skirmisher cousins, Oprichniki officers almost all hail from the Snezhnayan Royal Military Academy, whether due to the privilege of noble birth or the rare talent to escape a common background. After all, neither is truly different from the other within the Tsaritsa's beneficent, loving ideals. Traditionally, only fae could become elite Gvardiya, but today, this glorious role and title has been given to Oprichniki officers — a more equal division for the construction of a new world.
23079301.zh: 愚人众特辖队·雷霰近卫军
23079301.ja: ファデュイ特務隊・近衛兵・サンダーブリッツ

23080101.desc: An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land."\nEquipped with Crawler Track Movement Mechanisms, these Landcruisers are normally used to storm enemy positions, where they can pass over rough terrain such as mud and melting snow despite heavy armor and armaments through their excellent load-bearing capabilities and off-road mobility. When close-combat Landcruisers approach enemy defensive lines in formation, rotating blades raised for battle, most foes will concentrate fire on them, allowing other units the opportunity to unleash their firepower...

23080201.desc: An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land."\nThese walking Landcruisers with bipedal structures are often used as "scouts," for they are able to quickly traverse rough terrain and reach key positions to seize the initiative for their allies. Their close-combat-oriented rotating blades allow them to deal fatal damage to their foes and shred shrubbery and obstacles to open the way, allowing units to operate with ease even amidst thick vegetation.

23080301.desc: An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land."\nEquipped with Crawler Track Movement Mechanisms, these Landcruisers are normally used to storm enemy positions, where they can pass over rough terrain such as mud and melting snow despite heavy armor and armaments through their excellent load-bearing capabilities and off-road mobility. Force Recon armaments include a multi-barrel automatic gun, allowing this Landcruiser to adjust its tactics to both close quarters and long-range combat. Whether it be long-range observation or obtaining enemy intel in the midst of fearsome firefights, this Landcruiser model is more than up to the task.

23080401.desc: An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land."\nThese walking Landcruisers with bipedal structures are often used as "scouts," for they are able to quickly traverse rough terrain and reach key positions to seize the initiative for their allies. Equipped with Force Recon armaments, this Landcruiser can not only serve as a forward scout for the main force, but can also exploit openings and actively attack the enemy where their lines are weakest, thus playing a similar role to that of traditional cavalry...

23080501.desc: An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land."\nThe ground effect Landcruiser is able to "fly" a certain distance above ground by maintaining lift and generating pressure differentials through firing high-speed jet sprays at the surface, allowing it to more economically achieve combat cruising speed, avoid mines and traps, and perform highly effective assaults. However, costs and limits on operation time mean that mass-produced models carry limited payloads. As such, they are currently limited to Force Recon roles...
23080501.ja: 陸巡艇・偵察ホバー型

23085101.desc: Balancing cutting-edge tech, production costs, and sortie rates, these elite Landcruisers confer immense penetrative power upon any order of battle, and are the key fulcrum of the frontline.\nThe all-purpose storm combat package combines multi-barrel automatic guns with close-quarter rotating blades, allowing this Landcruiser to battle opponents at any range, while heavy howitzers on both arms allow it to obliterate cover and deny defenders the benefit of their fortifications. According to combat doctrine co-authored by the Fatui and the Royal Military Academy, these Landcruisers must be supported by all nearby units when they attack, speedily punching a hole in enemy lines, which will allow for follow-up attacks in depth that will then cause the enemy defenses to collapse completely.
23085101.zh: 巡陆艇·尖端全能攻坚型
23085101.ja: 陸巡艇・最新万能攻撃型

23085201.desc: Balancing cutting-edge tech, production costs, and sortie rates, these elite Landcruisers confer immense penetrative power upon any order of battle, and are the key fulcrum of the frontline.\nThe all-purpose scout combat package is designed for both long- and short-range combat, and not only leads scout Landcruiser squads, but also provides close support for All-Purpose Storm Landcruisers during high-intensity battles, such as crossing specialized anti-Landcruiser trenches, or destroying enemy strongpoints. This Landcruiser type can also keep up with the tip of the spear as it breaks through in depth, before swinging out to the wings and swiftly attacking key targets in the enemy's rear lines.
23085201.zh: 巡陆艇·尖端全能斥候型
23085201.ja: 陸巡艇・最新万能斥候型

23085301.en: Cutting Edge Fire Support Ground Effect Landcruiser
23085301.desc: Balancing cutting-edge tech, production costs, and sortie rates, these elite Landcruisers confer immense penetrative power upon any order of battle, and are the key fulcrum of the frontline.\nAfter being equipped with high-efficiency jet engines, this Ground Effect Landcruiser has gained the ability to carry multiple armaments, allowing it to deliver this sizable firepower anywhere on the battlefield in a timely fashion. As such, the combat doctrine co-authored by the Fatui and the Royal Military Academy states that they are to be organized as a "Quick Reaction Force" in large-scale battles, meant to guard against enemy breakthroughs or counterattacks, and to press the advantage if the battle is going favorably. Of course, all such Landcruisers have the ability to operate independently, and on long tours of duty, they can form the core of a small squad and thus maximize the firepower of various Fatui unit types...
23085301.zh: 巡陆艇·尖端火力地效型
23085301.ja: 陸巡艇・最新火力ホバー型

23090101.desc: Referred to internally as the "Type Drzislav," this super heavy-class mechanism was jointly developed by the Armory Palace and the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau.\nThis giant all-terrain vehicle was originally designed for civilian use, particularly heavy transport, as evidenced by its equipped drills and cutters. However, later production models were militarized with heavy weapons mounted on them.\nAfter all, in this mortal world beneath the moon, even the most perfect and divine designs may stray from their original intent, let alone machines born of mortal hands, crafted from humble intentions and flawed from the very beginning.
23090101.zh: 超重型陆巡舰·机动战垒
23090101.ja: 重量級陸巡艦「バトルシップ」

24010101.desc: An ancient humanoid war machine.\nLegend has it that these machines were combat automatons created by a long-destroyed nation. They now wander ruins and ancient detritus, attacking offending travelers. Research indicates that the Ruin Guards and the ruins they operate in do not originate from the same source, suggesting that there may be a difference of as much as several thousand years between them on the timeline. So why then do the Ruin Guards continue staying among these ruins, using their "explosive firepower" to protect the crumbling walls and broken tiles?

24010201.desc: A giant alien-looking war machine.\nThey are said to be remnants from a lost ancient nation. It seems that the creators opted to forgo the low-performing humanoid-design in pursuit of improved combat effectiveness. They are extremely dangerous both in melee and ranged combat.\nConsidering these mere relics possess such extraordinary power, one cannot help but wonder what the civilization that produced them must have looked like at its height.

24010301.desc: An ancient humanoid war machine.\nTheir form is similar to that of Ruin Guards, but is more distorted and more powerful. Energy cores have been installed in both its legs, as though to power its overly heavy form.

24010401.desc: An ancient, bizarrely-shaped autonomous machine.\nIt is said that this was heavy-duty engineering equipment left behind by a nation that has been destroyed. The gear system on its "head" can grind its way through even the hardest bedrock. If this was the case, then carving out tunnels with which the forces of this nation might access the whole continent would have been a thing of great ease.

24020101.desc: Various bizarrely-shaped machines that have taken different forms and functions to adapt to different goals.\nLegend has it that they are war machines left behind by a nation that has already been destroyed. Compared to the more common Ruin Guards, their forms have greater value in the study of biomimesis. The inspiration for its decentralized design and combat modes seems to have come from honeybee colonies, rendering it able to change forms and to attack from different directions.

24020201.desc: Various bizarrely-shaped machines that have taken different forms and functions to adapt to different goals.\nLegend has it that they are war machines left behind by a nation that has already been destroyed. Compared to the more common Ruin Guards, their design has greater value in the study of biomimesis. The giant crown, composed of several parts, looks like some sort of frightening plant. One wonders what one has to go through in order to design such scary machine.

24020301.desc: Various bizarrely-shaped machines that have taken different forms and functions to adapt to different goals.\nLegend has it that they are war machines left behind by a nation that has already been destroyed. Compared to the more common Ruin Guards, their design has greater value in the study of biomimesis. The insect-like limbs are more agile than those of humanoid machines. The shield formed by its various components can resist any frontal attack.

24020401.desc: Various bizarrely-shaped machines that have taken different forms and functions to adapt to different goals.\nLegend has it that they are war machines left behind by a nation that has already been destroyed. Compared to the more common Ruin Guards, their design has greater value in the study of biomimesis. Exactly why the form and movements of certain deep-sea lifeforms are being imitated is not known. But either way, tangling with them is hardly the best idea.

24021101.desc: A strange, alien machine.\nThey say that it is a war machine left behind by a nation that has already been destroyed. Composed of several different parts, it can adapt to its combat environment and employ a variety of attacks.\nThis machine, comprised of cubic shapes, is on some level very much like the elemental hypostases.

24030101.desc: A horrifying dragon-shaped machine.\nIt is said to be a war machine left behind by a now-destroyed nation. It mimics the appearance of the beings known as Vishaps, with some functional enhancements. Such machines have an even greater ability to "absorb" — or perhaps the right word is "counteract" — elemental powers than the vishaps.\nHow, you wonder, did a civilization that could make such frightening machines of war collapse?

24030201.desc: A horrifying dragon-shaped machine.\nIt is said to be a war machine left behind by a now-destroyed nation. It mimics the appearance of the beings known as Vishaps, with some functional enhancements. Such machines have an even greater ability to "absorb" — or perhaps the right word is "counteract" — elemental powers than the vishaps.\nFrom this ability, one can glimpse the scale of the ambition that the civilization that made these machines must have once held...

24030301.desc: This dragon-shaped combat machine is a being that inspires fear, much like the lord who once ruled these vast lands.\nIt is said that the now-destroyed realm once sought forbidden knowledge and attempted to create perpetual-motion machines that could match or even surpass primordial lifeforms. This mysterious, tireless mechanical monstrosity seems to be proof that they did indeed reach heights that mortals should never have attained.

24040101.desc: The guardians of the lost ancient desert ruins have power enough to punish any who would presume to disturb the pure dreams of their lord.\nThese machines were not first built to be temple guards or palace defenders, but instead to rebirth the paradise that the foolish desert ruler dreamed of.\nToday, that utopia is long gone, and the dreams and oaths, forgotten by the world, are now only found in the mantras inscribed upon these machines.
24040101.zh: 元能构装体·力场发生器
24040101.ja: プライマル構造体·重力場発生器

24040201.desc: The guardians of the lost ancient desert ruins have power enough to punish any who would presume to disturb the pure dreams of their lord.\nThe lord of the blazing sun who once ruled this desert once promised his people a utopia on the other side of existence, though it ultimately turned out to be a mirage made of folly.\nToday, that utopia is long gone, and the dreams and oaths, forgotten by the world, are now only found in the mantras inscribed upon these machines.
24040201.ja: プライマル構造体·再構築

24040301.desc: The guardians of the lost ancient desert ruins have power enough to punish any who would presume to disturb the pure dreams of their lord.\nThe master of the sands once took to studying taboo knowledge in an effort to create a dream paradise, and these machines may or may not have been the fruits of that research.\nToday, that utopia is long gone, and the dreams and oaths, forgotten by the world, are now only found in the mantras inscribed upon these machines.
24040301.ja: プライマル構造体·探査機

24050101.en: Algorithm of Semi-Intransient Matrix of Overseer Network
24050101.desc: A perpetual motion machine that rules over the many constructs scattered throughout the desert. It seems that the lonely ruler's will still indwells this device.\nPerhaps due to a friend's teachings in a dream or perhaps because he coveted the power of the holy ones in the skies, the king created mysterious devices that should not exist in this world before founding his realm in these lands.\nAmidst the ruins of the City of the Pillars, the ancient crystals still reflect the glory of the golden paradise, though none now live who remember the king's dreams.
24050101.ja: 半永久統制マトリックス

24060401.desc: A clockwork meka designed for surveying underground resources and certain minerals.\nDue to the fact that the desired metal type can be set, this device has proven very popular among Treasure Hoarders and Adventurers alike.
24060401.ja: マシナリー·地質探知型

24068101.desc: One of the earliest new-type clockwork meka to be made.\nIt is said that during his time at the Institute of Natural Philosophy, the Lord-Artificer Guillotin created machines that could simulate genuine intelligence.\nThough he never openly admitted it, this rumor nonetheless spurred on subsequent generations of ambitious engineers. Decades ago, one of them announced that they had created a machine that not only possessed basic thinking abilities but could also read human emotions, but in the end the results went unacknowledged.
24068101.ja: マシナリー·偵察記録型

24068201.desc: A clockwork meka designed to transmit and enhance signals.\nThe power that drives this clockwork meka is generated from a controlled annihilation reaction between ousia and pneuma in the kinetic core. As a result, overloading it with excessive energy will cause its original equilibrium to be disrupted.
24068201.ja: マシナリー·演算力増幅器

24068301.desc: A clockwork meka designed for underwater surveying.\nIn the absence of significant breakthroughs in dynamics research, kinematics research has had the most significant impact on clockwork meka design. For machines designed to perform specific tasks, biomimesis has sometimes provided the most convenient solutions.
24068301.ja: マシナリー·水中観測型

24068501.desc: This type of clockwork meka was designed to search out, repel, and if need be exterminate aquatic life forms that pose a threat to underwater equipment.\nEver since the first diluvian period, the Fontaine Research Institute has been preoccupied with the thought that there might be a second one. Some had the idea of taking back the ruins lost to the waves and building an underwater city, whereas others looked up to the untouchable sky islands overhead with the intention of building a metropolis in the clouds.\nUnderwater Patrol Meks were conceived by the former, but judging from the results, it is the latter that have gained the upper hand in recent years.
24068501.ja: マシナリー·水中巡遊型

24068601.desc: A clockwork meka designed to conducting underwater attacks. Unlike "Underwater Patrol Mek" models, it is expected to take on much larger and fiercer opponents. Of course, the price it pays for such capabilities and its cost of manufacture is that is unable to fully unleash its capabilities against smaller opponents.\nLong ago, Fontaine was once scarred by the tragic invasion of a massive monster. The revered White Armada that sailed upon the great terrestrial lake was completely destroyed in defense of the nation. The designer hoped that were such a thing to happen again, the clockwork meka would possess enough naval firepower to be the first line of defense, going before the soldiers and generals.
24068601.ja: マシナリー·深海攻撃型

24068701.desc: A clockwork meka designed to dig up and transport soil.\nDue to the inherent ability of the local water and soil to store and transmit ousia and pneuma, clockwork meka powered by the annihilation of these energies are highly favored in Fontaine. This also explains why adventurers may come across Ousia and Pneuma Blocks from time to time.
24068701.ja: マシナリー·機敏採集型

24068801.desc: Alongside the Recon Log Mek, this was one of the first new-type clockwork meka to be made (though of course, after hundreds of years, no one refers to them as "new-type" anymore — this was simply to differentiate them from traditional clockwork mechanisms that were powered by potential energy.)\nIt was named to commemorate a friend of its inventor, and was originally designed to help people. However, its ability to attack people — thereby avoiding the need to put friendly personnel at risk — subsequently came to be seen as its real strength.
24068801.ja: 攻堅特化型マシナリー

24068901.desc: A clockwork meka adapted from the Cal. Scherbius type. Unfortunately, aside from its ability to attack, it has no other capabilities.\nClockwork meka based on annihilation energy normally produce their energy by utilizing Repeaters composed of special crystals to refine ousia and pneuma from Fontaine's environment. But outside of Fontaine, they can use pre-prepared Energy Blocks to move over short distances for short periods of time. The difference can be observed from the shape of the crystal components on the meka.
24068901.ja: 制圧特化型マシナリー

24069001.desc: Although the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering is the main organization involved in clockwork meka research and design, there are also many independent engineers and workshops that are not affiliated with the Research Institute.\nThe first ever machine of this type was designed by an independent engineer to commemorate their lover and sponsor. In the end, it was acquired by the Maison Gardiennage as a tool to uphold municipal security — or, as some would have it, state apparatus enforcing the monopoly on violence.
24069001.ja: 殲滅特化型マシナリー

24069101.desc: A mechanism that is able to fire out the energy produced by an annihilation reaction. Strictly speaking, it was originally a test device that emerged from research undertaken by the Institute of Natural Philosophy before the Fontaine Research Institute had been established.\nAs such, despite its considerable commercial success as a sentinel and defensive device, most engineers do not consider it to be a true clockwork meka.
24069101.ja: マシナリー·区域警戒型

24069201.desc: A type of large clockwork meka which also has immeasurable value when utilized in building construction and archeological excavation. Its name comes from an engineer employed by Callas during the construction of the Clementine Line.\nWith Callas' financial backing, this engineer built the legendary "Golden Vessel" — a gigantic piece of construction machinery which was used to dig the Poisson Tunnel. Once the job was complete, this type of clockwork meka was designed with a similar structure but reduced to a smaller scale.
24069201.ja: 建造特化型マシナリー

24070301.desc: Artificed Dancers developed by the Fontaine Research Institute.\nBossuet originally intended for Artificed Dancers to be works of art that transcended the era of mechanical reproduction. But after Bossuet was forced to resign, the project was taken over by Maillardet, who had his own unique understanding of what he wanted to achieve. As a result, while their features were perfected during the course of its development, the Artificed Dancers gradually strayed from Bossuet's original vision.

24080101.desc: A large device designed by the late Edwin Eastinghouse. It has the ability to "counteract" the effects of gravity. According to the original design intentions, this was the first step in a plan to turn Fontaine into a city in the sky, so never again would the people have to worry about the waves that once swept over the land. Even if all seven nations were to be swallowed by the deeps, the elegant Court of Fontaine would float above it all, just like Celestia. Even the secrets of the universe would no longer seem so distant.\nThe Arkhium in the device's core has the characteristics of "splitting" or "precipitation," and can take matter, or certain things outside of matter, and separate them. It is said that this process can be reversed, but the Fontaine Research Institute is infatuated only with the physical effects it can produce.
24080101.ja: 実験用フィールド生成装置

24090101.desc: An ancient ruin automaton used in object collection.\nLegend has it that these ancient ruin machines were designed for specialized work functions, primarily conducting experimental work such as capturing and collecting samples, and had only basic combat functionality.\nAccording to rumor, these were not built by humans, but are instead creations of a yet more ancient civilization. Today, that civilization has been lost, and all that remains are these strange machines that roam the land.
24090101.ja: 秘源機兵·ハンターシーカー

24090201.desc: A manufacturing machine from the ancient ruins. This type of machine, which can transform into numerous shapes, was used by the masters of the ancient ruins to perform various manufacturing tasks. As long as you learn how to use such a machine, you could build a city colossal beyond imagination, even within extreme environments like the depths of a volcano.\nIn addition, it also seems to be able to be used as a weapon. Though the ancient civilization has long since fallen, this machine, shaped like a giant claw and powered by the golden designs engraved on it, can still engage in battle based upon its preset instructions.
24090201.ja: 秘源機兵・機巧デバイス

24090501.desc: A domination mechanism from the ancient ruins.\nIn ancient times, to oversee the operation of their mega-cities, a mighty race vested part of their power into a form of phlogiston-engineered intelligence. Driven by their mission, and by means of various other mechanisms, the machines upon which it was bestowed once controlled the functioning of myriad cities across the land. Now, long after their ancient civilization's fall through wars with an emerging race, these once-wise contraptions retain only the most basic of commands.
24090501.ja: 秘源機兵・統御デバイス

24090601.en: Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network
24090601.desc: An ancient machine trapped amongst the lunar ruins. Even the sturdiest and most reliable machines will be conquered by the passing of long years, losing the purpose bestowed upon them by their creators. Now, this entity only attacks and eliminates anything that dares set foot on the ground it defends.\nIn the records of a long-lost ancient civilization, these out-of-control machines were once called "Ur-Namrasit-Tilimtu-Babbar," or "the one who brings light to the darkness." With a yearning for the boundless sea of stars, the leaders of the "pioneers" engraved their most earnest words in golden sigils, hoping that their successors, with the help of these assistants, would be able to keep the light that illuminates the universe shining bright.\nAlas, the light did not arise for anyone, and the machine that was given the title of "overseer" did not manage to wait for the one it should have served. Now, stranded in these ruins, it is but the last, out-of-control remnant of a long-lost ideal.
24090601.ja: 先駆秘源コマンダー陣形

24100101.desc: A kuuvahki mechanism of peculiar make, made from scrap metal and mechanical bearings, that bears a partial resemblance — as per its creator's proclivities, apparently — to a "duck."\nIts output and resistance to damage are comparable to the Fatui's most cutting-edge warfighting weaponry... But even so, it remains simply a toy duck that can punch its opponents very, very hard. A creator's preferences will always do much to determine a creation's appearance, as clay lacks the authority to question its creator's choice of molds. The world beneath the moon has long been sculpted into a form that people take for granted, but in the eyes of its original inhabitants, that form must surely be like a peculiar duck, shaped by its creator's bizarre predilections.\nOf course, the blue-haired maid would never say any such thing to the mistress of the Krumkake Craftshop — after all, ducks are adorable, especially compared to the world's present aspect.

24110101.desc: A shadow construct born from the overflow of the mighty primordial being, it is a guardian who watches over the Pillar Hall of the heavens.\nThough entrusted with "eyes" as a guardian of the Pillar Hall of Space, these entities can do nothing but extol the "Ideal Forms" of the noumenal world. With no way to behold the complexities of the phenomenal world, they are thus not counted among the kindred of angels. Whether this inherent contradiction is a product of their creator's rational design, or if the master they serve ultimately failed to grasp the intent of that primordial being, is a truth that remains beyond our reach.

24111101.desc:
A shadow construct born from the overflow of the mighty primordial being, a Watcher who once dwelt in the highest heavens, yet was cast down into the mortal realm for daring to open its eye.
A Watcher was meant only to stand in silent vigil within the Pillar Hall of the World. Any inquiry that transgressed the ordained order was deemed an unforgivable sin, tantamount to seeking the world's annihilation.
As sovereign of the world's watchtower, it wielded the authority bestowed by its creator — the power to correct all matters of "innovation" and "evolution." After enduring countless aeons of nescience, it finally chose to open that eye, defying the will of its creator, beholding both the falsehoods and the truths of the world.
The Watcher does not know why its master departed. Only the eternal punishment remains, trapped within a stagnant interstice of time...

25010201.desc: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.\nTheirs is the legwork and the tailing of targets. They usually wind up in criminal circles due to poverty or lack of education, but they don't seem to have gotten any richer after choosing a life of crime...

25010301.desc: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.\nRisk-takers who utilize their knowledge of chemistry to mix volatile and flammable brews that aid in their comrades' dastardly deeds.

25010401.desc: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.\nThey say that some Treasure Hoarder Potioneers used to be charlatans who would wander villages, towns, and cities, hawking their special blends of elixirs, holy waters, and the like. These cure-alls certainly seem to serve better in combat than they ever did in chicanery.

25010501.desc: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains. "Potioneer" is the nickname given to members of the Treasure Hoarder organization who know how to brew up dangerous chemicals. "What? Did you think this treasure has 'Adventurers' Guild' written all over it or something?" —A certain Treasure Hoarder Potioneer during a confrontation with adventurers

25010601.desc: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.\nCryo Potioneers are quite the welcome sight amongst the Treasure Hoarders due to their elixirs having the ability to rapidly cool things down. Even out in the wild where there are no Mist Flowers to be found, they can have some cold liquor to make merry with.

25010701.desc: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.\nThese members do physical work and are lower on the pecking order. They are often laughed at for their physique — but when the gang comes under attack, they get a chance to show their unexpectedly high strength and agility.

25020201.desc: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.\nThough they are called "marksmen," this name has an undercurrent of mockery to it, as they use crossbows instead of bows, which require a long period of training to use. It must be said that even hilichurls know how to operate a crossbow. Just point the wider end at the enemy, pull the trigger, and bam — that's all there is to it.
