25030201.desc: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.\n"They say that we stand on the shoulders of giants. That means digging up the accumulated wealth of our forebears, taking them with us, and... uh, returning them to the economic cycle! What a noble endeavor, am I right?"\n—A certain Treasure Hoarder Gravedigger, while delving deep into a ruin.

25030301.desc: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.\n"Stealing? What do you mean, stealing? It's re-discovery, I tell you — the return of treasure to those who appreciate it! Makes everyone happy, to boot! How great is that, eh?"\n—A certain Treasure Hoarder Seaman, in response to a question posed by a doubtful recruit

25060101.desc: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.\nPassionate about battle and muscles, they are quite picky about food and will often boast of the benefits of having a fine musculature, leading to some dissatisfaction from their fellow Treasure Hoarders.

25070101.desc: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.\nThis person was originally a miner — one who, even with the allowance they were provided with after the closure of the Chasm, ended up with the Treasure Hoarders for various reasons.

25080101.desc: Samurai who have fallen into banditry. Though they are called the Nobushi, they do not have a centralized organization.\nHaving pursued the path of a martial artist for a long time, they possess highly advanced sword skills but no longer use them for good.\nSometimes, they even collude with the Treasure Hoarders or Fatui out of a greed for wealth — or simply to survive.

25080201.desc: Samurai who have fallen into banditry. Though they are called the Nobushi, they do not have a centralized organization.\nThey not only possess highly advanced sword skills, but can also carry out flame powder attacks using the elements. Objectively speaking, perhaps this method of winning goes against the path of a martial artist.\nSometimes they even collude with the Treasure Hoarders or Fatui out of a greed for wealth — or simply to survive.

25080301.desc: Samurai who have fallen into banditry. Though they are called the Nobushi, they do not have a centralized organization.\nThey possess highly-advanced sword skills and also use crossbows to ambush opponents, using any means to win. Those who have abandoned the title of a martial artist often abandon their dignity as well.\nSometimes they even collude with the Treasure Hoarders or Fatui out of a greed for wealth — or simply to survive.

25090101.desc:
A disciplined mechanical swordsman.
Doesn't seem to have the ability nor will to speak, but instead only seeks to communicate with crossed swords.
It is said that this machine was made using the memories of the first-generation master of a certain sword school. However, it malfunctioned, lost control, and was ultimately discarded.
Some sing that the machine's spirit still lingers in the place where its fate was ended. They also say that the vicious mask that serves as its guard was inspired by a famous oni from that era.

25100101.desc: Samurai who have fallen into banditry.\nThey possess highly advanced martial art skills but found no use for them for various reasons. Out of desperation, they have fallen onto the path of evil. They use paper seals, created from a Kamuna art that has been lost for centuries, to infuse their blades with the power of lightning.

25100201.desc: Samurai who have fallen into banditry.\nThey practiced martial arts since they were young, but lost the opportunity to serve the people due to certain reasons and turned from the righteous path. Their blade's edges are not cold like ordinary steel, but instead burn with a bitter flame. They seem to have used paper seals, created from a lost Kamuna art, to set their blades afire.

25130101.desc: Vila, born with wings and capable of flight.\nAccording to records, the Vila experienced numerous periods of turmoil in the century following the Tsaritsa's ascension. During this time, it is said that certain fae, dissatisfied with the Tsaritsa's policies regarding fae nobility, instigated a small-scale rebellion.\nThe rebellion was quickly quelled, but because the instigators were descendants of former Vila nobility, the incident caused a large-scale division within the Vila for a time.

25130201.desc: Winged Vila, capable of flying in the air.\nIt is said that the Vila were a fairy clan who followed the Belyi Tsar from the moment he began his conquest to unify the entire frozen tundra. Their ability to fly for short periods provides them with considerable mobility. Serving as Scouts to survey enemy forces or carrying out long-distance raids is well within their capabilities.\nMost members of the "Druzhna," a personal guard formed during the era of the Belyi Tsar, were Vila.

25131001.desc: Among the many Volkodlaks of Snezhnaya, these are the relatively sturdy ones.\nPossessing the strength of a beast and a humanoid body, their powerful upper limbs grant their throws greater power and make them more precise. Volkodlaks may not be proficient in the art of crafting Clotting Ice or the use of Elemental power, but when it comes to the mastery of physical strength, they rank among the top across the many fairy tribes.

25131201.desc: A relatively muscular type among the many Volkodlaks of Snezhnaya.\nPossessing the strength of a beast and a humanoid body, they have a natural, wild instinct for harnessing their own power. If an untrained human were to confront this kind of Volkodlak with a weapon, the victor would undoubtedly be the latter.

25131401.desc: Among the many Volkodlaks of Snezhnaya, they are the relatively small and agile type.\nPrecisely because of their agile movements and five senses that are more keen than those of humans, they can rely on instinct to dodge many attacks in battle, making them quite troublesome opponents in close-quarters combat.

25131601.desc: Among the many Volkodlaks of Snezhnaya, these belong to the relatively small and agile variety.\nThey possess senses more keen than those of humans. Whether it is their perception of Anemo currents and wind speed, or their vision in specific environments, these traits have become their unique advantages, allowing them to achieve a hit rate far higher than ordinary people when firing a Bow, crossbow, or Pyro artillery from long distances.

25132601.desc: A Volkodlak of the canine clan that typically appears somewhat lazy.\nAmong the many different Volkodlak clans, the canine clan tends to have a better reputation. They are loyal, friendly, and mostly docile in nature. However, when someone they have sworn loyalty to or a close friend is in danger, they will strike down those deemed as enemies in a berserk rage.\nIt is said that in a past war, their clan resisted His Majesty the Tsar to the very end for the sake of their king, and because of this, earned the favor of His Majesty the Tsar.

25132701.desc:
A Volkodlak that typically hides its slender body beneath a cloak to operate covertly.
It is said that long ago, the artisans of the Golden Acropolis, who had mastered the power of creation, forged the bodies of the fae for various purposes, and this particular type of Volkodlak was originally created to test the limits of reproduction.
However, following the catastrophic blow that reduced even that kingdom of citrinitas to Ruins, the long-eared tribe survived to the present day due to their vast numbers.
Now, they are the masters of their own bodies. Moreover, their agility, allowing them to move nimbly even in the snow, makes them a threat that those crossing the snowfields must approach with caution.

25132801.desc:
A cunning Volkodlak that disguises its hand cannon as a tree trunk.
Because it excels at disguising the weapons and goods it carries, it is often commissioned for work such as transporting cargo or passing on intelligence.
Its hand cannon was likely crafted during its spare time. Sometimes, it also uses the hand cannon to fire signal flares disguised as fireworks.
Do not be deceived by its appearance; it is actually a highly shrewd and cunning sprite.

25133601.desc: A Volkodlak that has grown extremely powerful by inheriting more of the mighty power in its bloodline.\nAmong the many different Volkodlaks, those resembling giant elephants or mammoths possess one of the most noble bloodlines. In the past, their clans produced many remarkable warriors, many of whom were even loyal attendants to the King of Beasts.\nHowever, the greater their individual strength and the longer their lifespans, the harder it is for such fairies to form a community. Compared to other Volkodlaks, this kind is much rarer in present-day Snezhnaya.

25133701.desc: Volkodlaks that have become exceptionally powerful by inheriting a greater share of the mighty power within their bloodlines.\nTheir clans once prospered to the point of forming an independent army under the command of the King of Beasts. However, after the Belyi Tsar unified the frozen expanses as the master of the Pale Star Court, these clans—having suffered no great losses in the war—were distrusted and fell into a gradual decline, leaving the center of power in Snezhnaya around the time the Tsaritsa ascended to the throne. Today, the Volkodlaks of the wolf packs mostly dwell in snowfields and mountain forests.

25135001.desc:
Snegovik, born for love amidst the Cryo and snow.
The females among the Snegovik are called Snegurochka, and most of them are born as Mages capable of freely wielding the power of Cryo and snow. Legend has it that Snegovik were created with incomplete souls, and must fall in love with a human to become Perfect.
But do Snegovik still need love after becoming Perfect? Perhaps the answer is no.
This is perhaps the reason why so many Stories of Snegovik and humans falling in love ultimately end in tragedy.

25135101.desc:
The Snegovik, born amidst Cryo and snow for love.
The males among the Snegovik are natural knights, most of whom are born with the ability to freely manipulate Cryo and snow to forge their own Weapons.
Legendary tales state that during the battle in which the Belyi Tsar resisted the pitch-black tide of Athame Artis, a Snegovik serving as his guard unleashed a power not belonging to its kind, its form growing to a considerably massive size.
Although its ultimate fate remains unknown, breaking a taboo surely could not have resulted in a good outcome.

25137001.desc: A Leshy growing in the wild.\nPossessing only incomplete sentience and unable to speak, the Leshy appears to be the result of early experiments by craftsmen of the Kingdom of Citrinitas. However, the exact opposite is true: according to records, they only created this race of fairies after almost completely mastering the authority of life.\nPerhaps this contains a Verity that present-day fairies and humans cannot comprehend.

25138001.desc: Leshy that grow in the forests and wilds.\nAmong the many fairies of Snezhnaya, the Leshy is an exceptionally unique kind, almost never appearing in cities. Among all fairies, the Leshy is perhaps the most long-lived; few other Changsheng races have witnessed the entire lifespan of a Leshy. However, most people probably cannot even distinguish one Leshy from another.

25140101.desc: A byproduct created by the alchemist named Koshchei during the creation of an entity named the Pyro Bird.\nPerhaps it was a habit of this gloomy alchemist: once a certain experimental subject in the same batch was a success, the rest would be discarded or casually disposed of.\nAnd this derivative creation, which was supposed to fuse with a certain power to become a complete entity, can now only wander the mountain gorges endlessly as an incomplete and mindless beast.

25210101.desc: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.\nThese ax-wielding ladies often wade into the slaughter without fear, creating openings for their comrades to capitalize on.\nThey will sometimes sit by the fireside in their sand-swept homeland and play songs that were lost in that golden sea.
25210101.ja: エルマイト旅団·アックス

25210201.desc: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps hailing from a place where the sands shine like gold. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.\nThe Eremite tradition is to use bows to engage their foes, but ever since the Akademiya permitted them to buy crossbows at the bazaars, only the proudest shooters would still use bows, which take many years of practice to master.
25210201.ja: エルマイト旅団·クロスボウ

25210301.desc: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.\nThese warriors use Ravenbeak Halberds in battle. It is said that ascetics who served the deity of the desert would carry these halberds as symbols of their office. These weapons once had a true name, but it has long been lost to the desert sands.
25210301.ja: エルマイト旅団·ベクドコルバン

25210401.desc: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.\nThis warrior wields a unique fist blade and joined the Eremites to seek out stronger foes. Rather than the pay, these warriors fight more to attain greater martial might.
25210401.ja: エルマイト旅団·ラインブレイカー

25210501.desc: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.\nThis desert warrior wields a large curved blade in battle. The skills such fighters boast of have been passed down since the days when their now-lost civilization was still extant, and are not only techniques to be used in battle, but also serve well as a performing art popular in various lands.\nIt is said that this sword art was once practiced from horseback.
25210501.ja: エルマイト旅団·ソードダンサー

25310101.desc: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.\nA young lady lost in the ancient dream of the desert songs. To her, the thrill of bloody battle is her true reward. Legend has it that the women of this tribe are often afflicted by the wandering spirits of the desert, a condition that leads many of them to an early end. Perhaps this one can only be free of these apparitions when her blood is up in combat.\nAn ominous, fragmented spirit is sealed within the weapon she uses, awakening in moments of peril. Once it does, it can only be silenced by the cries of the vanquished — whether that be its wielder, or its wielder's foe.
25310101.ja: エルマイト旅団·サンドウォーター

25310201.desc: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.\nA professional mercenary who cares about nothing outside of work and the mission at hand. To such people, their only game plan is to complete the mission, and their high asking prices on the market match that committment.\nAn ominous, fragmented spirit is sealed within the weapon they use, awakening in moments of peril. Once it does, it can only be silenced by the cries of the vanquished — whether that be its wielder, or its wielder's foe.
25310201.ja: エルマイト旅団·サンフロスト

25310301.desc: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.\nA true scion of a warrior tribe, such warriors see battle as their ordained purpose, and unlike some barbarian who wields a large ax with ease, these tribespeople are also quite well-versed in the lore and songs of the desert ruins.\nAn ominous, fragmented spirit is sealed within the weapon they use, awakening in moments of peril. Once it does, it can only be silenced by the cries of the vanquished — whether that be its wielder, or its wielder's foe.
25310301.ja: エルマイト旅団·デイサンダー

25410101.desc: A person hailing from the loosely-organized mercenary bands of the desert. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.\nIn ancient days, these heavily-equipped warriors were the domain of the personal, trusted guards of the Lord of the Blazing Sun. It is perhaps on this account that they gleam like the golden sun itself to this day.\nOminous, fragmented spirits are sealed within the weapons they use, awakening in moments of peril. Once these weapons awaken, they can only be silenced by the cries of the vanquished — whether that be their wielders or their wielders' foes.
25410101.ja: エルマイト旅団·ストーンエンチャンター

25410201.desc: A person hailing from the loosely-organized mercenary bands of the desert. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.\nIn this age where crossbows are in widespread use, only the most experienced of Eremite warriors know how to use a longbow in battle. They do not even need their eyes — merely their ears with which they sense the flow of wind and sand alike — to judge the location of their foes.\nOminous, fragmented spirits are sealed within the weapons they use, awakening in moments of peril. Once these weapons awaken, they can only be silenced by the cries of the vanquished — whether that be their wielders or their wielders' foes.
25410201.ja: エルマイト旅団·ゲイルハンター

25410301.desc: A person hailing from the loosely-organized mercenary bands of the desert. Even though they will work for anyone as long as the pay is good, they will never forget their roots in the Great Red Sand.\nAfter the collapse of its civilizations, the stories of the desert were passed down generation after generation in oral tradition just like the sparks in the wind and the rain in the clouds. As time passed, some stories were lost while others survived, albeit with significant changes.\n"The Eremites" is the umbrella term given to the tribes of the desert by those too ignorant or disdainful to learn the tribes' myriad differences. Within those referred to as the Eremites, many have also indeed already forgotten the tales of the desert. Fear not, however, for those who still remember will never betray the spirit of the sands yet flowing through their veins.
25410301.ja: エルマイト旅団·サンドロアマスター

25410401.desc: A person hailing from the loosely-organized mercenary bands of the desert. They will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.\nThe children of the desert have a rich tradition of song and dance. Originally used to praise and serve the gods, the crafts were later adapted for battle and the seduction of kings. Many tales of the sands feature dancers who murdered kings relaxed in their beds or standing atop high towers. Even though all such gods and kings have now faded into the flowing sands, the memory of dance yet persists in the desert-dwellers' veins.\nOminous, fragmented spirits are sealed within the weapons they use, awakening in moments of peril. Once these weapons awaken, they can only be silenced by the cries of the vanquished — whether that be their wielders or their wielders' foes.
25410401.ja: エルマイト旅団·フローラルリングダンサー

25500101.desc: A warrior from the source of the springs, and a tribal guardian that patrols the waters and shores.\nIn lieu of weapons, these tribal warriors have mastered the techniques of raw, physical combat. Their seemingly ordinary fists and feet contain the power equal to the crashing waves.

25500201.desc: A warrior from the clifftops, and a tribal guardian that patrols the steep mountain ridges.\nThese tribal warriors trust their own two hands more than any weapon. Above all else, they are renowned for their lithe and agile bearing.
25500201.ja: 結羽の勇士・空を舞う者

25501101.desc: A valiant warrior of the canyon, and a tribal guardian who patrols the crystal mountains and rivers.\nA tribal warrior wielding a ball-headed club, she can turn even the hardest of rocks into dust with her crushing blows. When not using her weapon to fight, she instead often smashes open rocks in search of precious gems and traces of phlogiston crystals.
25501101.ja: 鋳砂の勇士·インタロゲイター

25501201.desc: A warrior from the Canopy, and a tribal guardian that patrols the forest valleys and mountain streams.\nUnlike the warriors of other tribes, these warriors, ever swinging around the mountains using their grappling hooks, are always considering how to defeat their opponents with unexpected attacks.

25501301.desc: A warrior from the clifftops, and a tribal guardian that patrols the steep mountain ridges.\nProud sword wielders whose blade strokes are as sweeping as a Qucusaur's outstretched wingspan. Blood sprays forth like scattered feathers from the wounds they inflict.
25501301.ja: 結羽の勇士・羽を削ぐ者

25501401.desc: A warrior from the Night-Wind, and a tribal guardian that patrols the misty canyons.\nTo a certain degree, they can draw upon the power of their body paint to wield their weapons with their willpower.

25502101.desc: A warrior from the Canopy, and a tribal guardian that patrols the forest valleys and mountain streams.\nIt is said that these sword-wielding tribal warriors stand under trees and cut every leaf that falls over the course of a day in order to hone their fighting skills. But just as leaves fall silently, so are the slashes of these swift couriers soundless.
25502101.ja: 迅疾の勇士·ストームスカウト

25502201.desc: A warrior from the source of the springs, and a tribal guardian that patrols the waters and shores.\nThese warriors always lead the charge, and the swords in their hands are as teeth that saw through bone. The members of the tribe who practice the sword do so in the water, honing their skill and strength against the resistance of the water itself. The best among them can cleave a swimming fish in two.
25502201.ja: 流刃の勇士·グリースソウ

25502301.desc: A warrior from the Night-Wind, and a tribal guardian that patrols the misty canyons.\nIt is said that their body paint is an art that evolved from the practice of Phlogiston Engraving, and that it takes long years of training to fully master the power contained within.

25502401.desc: A warrior from the plains and a tribal guardian who watches over the golden fields.\nThey are adept at using their horn-studded blades to strike at enemy weak spots — be careful not to let them detect any of yours.
25502401.ja: 猛進の勇士・スマッシャー

25503101.desc: A warrior from the Canopy, and a tribal guardian that patrols the forest valleys and mountain streams.\nMany wonder if claymores are too heavy to be wielded by the couriers of the Scions of the Canopy, but perhaps it is precisely because their duties are heavier still that a weapon more capable of deterrence is a necessity.
25503101.ja: 迅疾の勇士·重刃の伝達使

25503201.desc: A warrior from the Night-Wind, and a tribal guardian that patrols the misty canyons.\nOnly sentries whose strength has been tested are permitted to daub themselves with such body paint, infused as it is with mysterious powers. This also signifies that these warriors have reached a new phase in their mental training.

25504101.desc: A valiant warrior of the canyon, and a tribal guardian that patrols the crystal mountains and rivers.\nTribal warriors wielding massive warhammers with both hands, they are the vanguard that is the first to breach the enemy's defensive lines. For the Children of Echoes, who delight in gemstones and all manner of crafted ornaments, hammers are often the first tool to be touched by the tribe's warriors as children.
25504101.ja: 鋳砂の勇士·シールドブレイカー

25504201.desc: A warrior from the clifftops, and a tribal guardian that patrols the steep mountain ridges.\nBy observing and emulating the claw strikes of airborne Saurians, these warriors have grasped the essence of harnessing their own power. Their kicks, delivered from up high, should not be underestimated.
25504201.ja: 結羽の勇士・空を統べる者

25504301.desc: A warrior from the plains and a tribal guardian who watches over the golden fields.\nThey have trained their strength relentlessly since the moment they set their sights on becoming a warrior. When they bring their two-handed weapon down in a mighty strike, the sheer force is something no ordinary person can withstand.
25504301.ja: 猛進の勇士・マイティガイ

25505101.desc: A valiant warrior of the canyon, and a tribal guardian that patrols the crystal mountains and rivers.\nIn an era when the ridges were shattered and the tribes needed to rebuild, the warriors used javelins as markers to determine the locations on both sides of the canyon from which passages should be dug. That meant that each javelin had to be sunk deep into the rock.
25505101.ja: 鋳砂の勇士·ジャベリニア

25505201.desc: A warrior from the source of the springs, and a tribal guardian that patrols the waters and shores.\nUnderestimate the incredible skills these brave harpoon-wielding warriors have gained through hunting and fishing at your peril. It is said that in the past, tribespeople would use these skills to hunt massive sea beasts with fins and scales as tough as iron.
25505201.ja: 流刃の勇士·ジャベリックスロワー

25505301.desc: A warrior from the plains and a tribal guardian who watches over the golden fields.\nThe art of unarmed combat is regarded with great honor among the Collective of Plenty. Warriors who embark on the long path of training for such an art must possess the strength to hurl a spear a thousand yards.
25505301.ja: 猛進の勇士・グラップラー

25510101.desc: A powerful warrior from the canyon, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown.\nA warrior who can strike with the power of a rockfall. Even among the Children of Echoes, who live and breathe rock and crystal, Saurian-Crowned Warriors are masters who understand rock and stone better than any. It is said they can even divine the purity and grain of the interior of raw ore merely by looking at the rough exterior.
25510101.ja: テペトル竜戦士·砕晶のハンマー

25510201.desc: A powerful warrior from the canyon, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown.\nA warrior who can strike with the power of a rockfall. Legend holds that the Sulfurous Veins were once a more complete and more beautiful mountain range, and it was only when the Black Tide came that the Saurian-Crowned warriors of the Children of Echoes carved the earth itself to guide the tide, giving the Veins their current appearance.
25510201.ja: テペトル竜戦士·砕岩のブレード

25510301.desc: A powerful warrior from the Canopy, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown.\nA warrior who can use a grappling hook to extend their attack range. Grappling hooks are an indispensable part of daily life for the Scions of the Canopy. However, only the wildest warriors will combine the hooks with sawblades to create a weapon both exceptionally lethal and difficult-to-control.
25510301.ja: ユムカ竜戦士·飛葉の丸鋸

25510401.desc: A powerful warrior from the Canopy, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown.\nA warrior who can use a grappling hook to extend their attack range. Following intricate mechanical tinkering, the handcannon they wield can be fired using said grappling hook. For the Saurian-Crowned warriors of the Scions of the Canopy, refining one's skills and thought is more important than training the spirit and will.
25510401.ja: ユムカ竜戦士·鳴空の大砲

25510501.desc: A powerful warrior from the source of the springs, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown.\nA warrior who can temporarily harness the power of the waves to shuttle back and forth. According to legend, the tribe's heroes can take advantage of exceptional speed to move across the waves with no need of any tool. Today, the tribe believes this to be a sophisticated, complex art used to drive the waves, with the way one moves being at its heart.
25510501.ja: コホラ竜戦士·裂波のスロワー

25510601.desc: A powerful warrior from the source of the springs, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown.\nA warrior who can temporarily harness the power of the waves to shuttle back and forth. It is said that one must undergo three states of training to master this skill: First, to adapt. Second, to submit. Finally, to drive. Mastering this method of movement is merely the entry-level requirement to become a Saurian-Crowned Warrior of the People of the Springs, and the greatest among these Warriors can even use this skill to sail on land.
25510601.ja: コホラ竜戦士·裂礁のガトリング

25510701.desc: A powerful warrior from the clifftops, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown.\nEven in Natlan, the Nation of Pyro, members of the Flower-Feather Clan have a unique approach when it comes to wielding fire and flames. For these tribal warriors, armed as they are with heavy hammers, flames are something that burst forth from violent collisions, symbols of intense passion. When they do battle, the fight usually ends within an instant— and they are always the ones who stand victorious.
25510701.ja: クク竜戦士・鍛冶の槌

25510801.desc: A powerful warrior from the clifftops, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown.\nAmong the many varieties of Saurians, the Qucusaurs stand particularly proud, and this is a trait that is shared by the Qucusaurus Warriors who are able to obtain their recognition. It is said that in the past, tribal warriors would watch these crimson Saurians amuse themselves by tossing flaming stones from great heights; and that it was this that first inspired them to set off projectiles to cause explosive chain reactions. This concept, gradually refined over time, is said to have been the origin of many of the Flower-Feather Clan's firearms.
25510801.ja: クク竜戦士・蒼天の焔

25510901.desc: A powerful warrior from the Night-Wind, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown.\nTribal warriors from the Masters of the Night-Wind do not typically excel when it comes to conventional strength. Their ability to manipulate weapons with ease comes instead from years of mental training. Thus, compared to combat prowess in itself, warriors from the Masters of the Night-Wind place greater value on the gift of "Spiritspeaking." Drawing upon the power of special graffiti and willpower alone, it is said that the most exceptional of Spiritspeakers can lift boulders as tall as people.
25510901.ja: イクトミ竜戦士・寒流を運ぶ者

25511001.desc: A powerful warrior from the Night-Wind, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown.\nWithout exception, it is said that tribal warriors who win the acknowledgment of the Iktomisaurs must possess extraordinarily keen senses and formidable mental strength. They can even use their power to make slight alterations to the trajectory of the projectiles that they fire from their cannons.
25511001.ja: イクトミ竜戦士・氷晶の砲手

25511101.desc: A powerful warrior from a land of plenty, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown.\nIt is said that the warriors of the Collective of Plenty like to deal powerful strikes while dashing at their foes — a lesson learned from the Tatankasaurs who share their lands. This is especially true for those warriors who wield heavy weapons, and claim the secret to a successful blow is to swing from the hips.
25511101.ja: ライノ竜戦士・破空の響動

25511201.desc: A powerful warrior from a land of plenty, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown.\nAmong the Collective of Plenty, even those warriors who have painstakingly trained to use long-range weapons are known to be skilled in hand-to-hand combat. Perhaps, to them, ranged weapons are better for bludgeoning than firing projectiles.
25511201.ja: ライノ竜戦士・霊明の追縛

25520101.desc: A priestess of the Masters of the Night-Wind who has lived apart from her tribe, honing her abilities in utter solitude. It is said that her Spiritspeaking powers surpass those of ordinary priests and shamans, a result of having had the protection of the Masters of the Night-Wind's Wayob bestowed upon her. Both a blessing and a curse, these powers were at first beyond her ability to control, which was why she set out to master them in isolation from her tribe. Though she has since done so, to this day she still lives in seclusion, a habit that has earned her a reputation as a loner and a recluse. Rumor has it, however, that she is more than willing to teach those who seek her guidance — though always on her own terms...

26010101.desc: A mimetic plant monster that appears out of nowhere and uses Cryo in combat.\nThese plants lurk under the surface and ambush unsuspecting prey. With the passage of years, sufficient nutrition, and the right environment, it could even take root somewhere and grow into a giant Cryo Regisvine...

26010201.desc: A mimetic plant monster that attacks without warning and uses Pyro to hunt its prey.\nThe world of Teyvat plays host to plants infused with the elements. Having gained a measure of intellect, their "nutritional needs" have also greatly increased...

26010301.desc: Energetic mimetic Plant monsters that use Electro to attack their prey.\nWhen fully-charged with Electro energy, they can unleash a strong electric current from their crowns. As such, some researchers have tried to apply them in other areas...

26020101.desc: A monster formed from a vine that was imbued with the essence of biting frost within the ley lines.\nSome studies suggest that plants are like the organs of the world, harmonizing the turbulent elemental energies of the ley lines. Concrete examples of this phenomena are Mist Flowers, Whopperflowers, and the like, which brim over with elemental energy.\nIn certain circumstances, certain plants will turn into creatures of monstrous size and intent — such as the Cryo Regisvines — in the course of many years.

26020201.desc: A giant vine that has absorbed the ancient flame that rages within the ley lines.\nIt is restless as if filled with endless fury.\nPoets, bards, and even some academics believe that elements also contain emotions and hopes. If this is true, then one can only wonder what emotions cause the Pyro Regisvine to burn eternally, writhing like one longing to be free of the confines of the earth...

26020301.desc: A huge vine that has morphed into a monster through the conduction of high-voltage currents through the Ley Lines.\nElectricity surges constantly from its canopy like the unending rage of the earth itself.\nKshahrewar researchers once submitted that a complex circuit matrix might be set up around this creature to carry electrical energy to the city for use there. This plan was stridently opposed by scholars from Spantamad, who sacrificed 10 Shroomboars to drive home the point about the dangers of utilizing electricity.

26030101.desc: A young vishap with a hard Geo exoskeleton.\nVishaps are exceptionally agile creatures that one would be wise not to underestimate in battle. Experts from Sumeru Akademiya believe that they become dragons when fully grown. By avoiding predators and natural disasters, perhaps they can even live long enough to become formidable beasts that reign over entire mountains.
26030101.ja: ベビーヴィシャップ·岩

26040101.desc: A mature Geovishap.\nIt is said that after many years have passed, Geovishap Hatchlings will shed the armor that originally protected them and become Geovishaps. However, these two and the older, greater Primo Geovishaps have spent many years hibernating under the mountains, and have only emerged and become active in recent times. As such, none can personally attest to having witnessed or recorded such a thing in person.

26050101.desc: After many years, the awesomely powerful Primo Geovishaps grow accustomed to changes in their elemental environment.\nFolktales hold that after the great "draconic calamity" that led to the ruination of Tianqiu Valley, the overlord of the Geovishaps and Primo Geovishaps was imprisoned deep beneath the earth, and so too did they burrow into deep and unseen places, awaiting their chance to rise once more...
26050101.ja: エンシェントヴィシャップ·岩

26050601.desc: A vishap that dwells deep beneath the oceans.\nThey were once the dominant race in the depths — and indeed, dragons were the overlords of the whole world in an even earlier age. But their former Seven Sovereigns were defeated by a power from the heavens, withering one by one.
26050601.ja: アビサルヴィシャップ·原種

26050701.desc: A vishap that dwells deep beneath the oceans. Due to certain social adaptations, it has manifested a form aligned with the Cryo element.\nThe coming of humans sparked a conflict and a resultant evolution within the Bathysmal Vishaps, just as ants might divide up labor and biological characteristics, thus appearing in different forms. These vishaps are stronger than their ordinary kin.
26050701.ja: アビサルヴィシャップ·噛氷

26050801.desc: A vishap that dwells deep beneath the oceans. Due to certain social adaptations, it has manifested a form aligned with the Electro element.\nFollowing the fading of the Seven Sovereigns' power, a new generation of Sovereigns is presently being born. But now that the Bathysmal Vishaps have evolved in this manner, they have lost their purity. As such, the Dragon of Water will no longer be born from among their ranks. Prophecy holds that the new Dragon of Water will definitely descend in the form of a human.
26050801.ja: アビサルヴィシャップ·吞雷

26060101.desc: Little creatures that can ever so slightly manipulate Electro.\nThey and other such creatures are known collectively as Cicins, and though they are individually weak, they can cause significant damage under the right circumstances.

26060201.desc: Little creatures that can ever so slightly manipulate Hydro.\nThey and other such creatures are known collectively as Cicins, and they truly adore the rare and wonderful Mist Grass plant. It is by exploiting this relationship that the Fatui Mages have sought to commandeer Cicins in battle.

26060301.desc: Little creatures that can ever so slightly manipulate Cryo.\nThey and other such creatures are known collectively as Cicins. They are individually very weak, but it is precisely because they are weak that they have evolved unique methods of movement that allow them to avoid predators.

26090101.desc: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability.\nIt is said that it tastes awful. However, such fungi have lots of moisture within them, and so can be used as an emergency water source...

26090201.desc: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability.\nA researcher once said that these are some species of Dendro Specter. After this view was criticized, he changed his tack, claiming that this was just a literary turn of phrase.

26090301.desc: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability.\nThis mushroom may have a sizable cap, but the umbrella-shaped structure is in fact hollow, and thus does not make for a particularly good meal.

26090401.desc: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability.\nResearch has shown that this sort of fungal beast's internal electric current will change periodically. If further developed, perhaps this study may give rise to a wide range of uses...

26090501.desc: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability.\nPutting Fungi on ice does not make them taste any better, but it does at least help with relieving the heat.

26090601.desc: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability.\nDue to the abundant amount of Pyro these creatures contain, they have a tendency to cause forest fires during dry seasons, and thus are considered a dangerous invasive species to the forest.

26090701.desc: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability.\nThis creature only looks explosive — it is, in fact, a most gentle soul, so long as you don't get too close...

26090801.desc: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability.\nThis mushroom quickly absorbs nutrients through its extended column, and its umbrella-shaped cap turns where the wind's flow carries it.

26090901.desc: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability.\nThese shrooms' caps have hard outer layers derived from concretions of Geo energy. Its bodily structure is also quite likely to be denser than others of its kind so as to withstand the heavy weight of its cap.

26091001.desc: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability.\nUnlike other Fungi, this creature possesses a cap with a luminous tendril sticking out of it. When in danger, it will release small electric orbs as a form of self-defense.

26100101.desc: A reptile that has mutated after feeding from greater lifeforms.\nMajestic beasts are sometimes revered by human beings as the embodiment of a greater power, their visages turned to analogy to feed in reference to a person, feeding their ego. However, the majority of beasts that have absorbed the "greater power" were slain by the overwhelming nature of the power itself. Only a few among their number evolved new forms.

26100201.desc: A predator that has mutated after feeding from greater lifeforms.\nSurvival of the fittest is written in the law of nature. But pets and Consecrated Beasts are exceptions. Human beings' baits and the remains of immortal beings are essentially deliberate or unintentional traps. The price of coveting the gift of the strongest is much more painful than being locked in a cage.

26100301.desc: A scavenging bird of prey that has mutated after feeding from greater lifeforms.\nThe greater lifeforms devoured by Consecrated Beasts often have nigh-immortal consciousness that can never be fully silenced or eradicated. The very power and consciousness gained by Consecrated Beasts devouring these lifeforms will, in turn, drive them to seek more violence and carrion.

26100401.desc: An arthropod that has mutated after feeding from greater lifeforms.\nLifeforms are governed by the laws of evolution, Consecrated Beasts exploited these rules by being fortunate enough to discover a long-dead carcass of a greater being before any of their competition ever did. Animals and humans often have far more in common than the latter is willing to acknowledge.

26100501.desc: A reptile that has mutated after feeding from greater lifeforms.\nThough now imbued with the power of elemental manipulation, the Consecrated Beasts themselves still cannot fully digest the pieces of flesh they devoured from the immortal carcasses that they ate. Instead, the pieces slowly fused with the beasts themselves, weaving a bony shell over their body, one that shares a similar composition to a certain type of smelting material from Inazuma.

26110101.desc: Over many long years, this large fungal beast has morphed into a unique form.\nIts intelligence has already reached and perhaps has even surpassed real animals, and it will actively hunt prey to obtain sustenance. Its tail has a lovely jade plumage that seems very similar to that of the ancient sacred beast that the Spantamad school reveres. As far as the logic of mimesis is concerned, it seems quite likely that the two beings once walked the earth together.

26120101.desc: A mimetic life form made out of spores that has extreme adaptability.\nGoing well past mere appearances, this being even imitates the habits of birds. It can use its spore-built wings to fly in the sky, spreading yet more spores to yet more distant places.\nThis creature has a position of command amongst colonies of Fungi and exhibits heightened intelligence to match.
26120101.ja: パタパタ草マッシュロン

26120201.desc: A mimetic life form made out of spores that has extreme adaptability.\nGoing well past mere appearances, this being even imitates the habits of birds. When it flies about, it will scatter icy flowers in its wake. These crystal cores, too, are spores.\nThis creature has a position of command amongst colonies of fungal beasts and exhibits heightened intelligence to match.
26120201.ja: パタパタ氷マッシュロン

26120301.desc: A mimetic life form made out of spores that has extreme adaptability.\nThis creature may look like a bird, but it cannot fly. Due to the influence of Hydro energies, it is astoundingly agile compared to others of its kind. Some research has inferred that this creature is in fact an aggregation of countless tiny spores rather than a single entity.\nThis creature has a position of command amongst colonies of Fungi and exhibits heightened intelligence to match.
26120301.ja: トコトコ水マッシュロン

26120401.desc: A mimetic life form made out of spores that has extreme adaptability.\nThis being has undergone almost complete keratinization due to the influence of Geo. When one considers that Fungi evolved from spores, perhaps this one might even be the foundation for a further evolution into some new life form altogether — if given time, that is.\nThis creature has a position of command amongst colonies of fungal beasts and exhibits heightened intelligence to match.
26120401.ja: トコトコ岩マッシュロン

26130101.desc:
An eyeless predator that dwells within the depths of the desert and uses sound and vibrations to seek out its prey.
Legend has it that in the ancient past before even the concept of time was created, these creatures thrived with their progenitors and offspring in a land of verdant grass and colossal trees, traversing through slick soil like fishes diving through the wet.
With the passage of eons, the gifts of heaven have long reduced the soils to sand, rendering a great many creatures extinct. This branch of their genus was able to survive by adapting more toward earth-based living, and became known as the "Wenut."
Some desert folk still mistakenly believe that Wenut is the final point of a quicksand eel's life cycle, likely due to superficial similarities between the species' behaviors.

26140101.desc: A centaur-shaped golem forged of marble and brass. Under the hard stone exterior flows Ichor blood. Towering as one who commands a legion, it is ready to trample any foe that might transgress against its honor.\nThe now sunken civilization believed that war was as music, an art of rhythms to be followed. Therefore, one who marshals a legion must be like a conductor, whose shield and sword are like the strings and bow of a violin, performing a blazing melody like the raging flames upon the merciless battlefield.\n"War is a necessary evil on the path to all-encompassing peace." Thus spake a Harmost, one who once led the golem legions to conquest over the entire high sea.

26140201.desc: A moving statue shaped like a warrior who will swing their sword at all who dare trespass upon the area under their guardianship. It is unclear if it is a soul or magic that powers them.\nThey say that legions of golems once conquered the nations that called the high sea home, and this might have been amongst their number. The great towers and palaces that now sleep beneath the waves once bore witness to the fate of those who stand in the path of the wheel of fate.

26151001.desc: A stingray that can release blades of water.\nAmong the Fontemer Aberrants, there are certain strange "Xenochromatic" lifeforms. It is said that these are not actually living creatures, but rather spirits from the ocean that have neither taken physical form nor swallowed bait. They are said to bestow blessings upon those accepted by the Fontemer as well as those that are able to control it. Of course, those that have a deeper understanding of natural philosophy would discount such groundless speculation.

26151101.desc: A stingray that can release blades of water.\nAmong the Fontemer Aberrants, there are certain strange "Xenochromatic" lifeforms. It is said that these are not actually living creatures, but rather spirits from the ocean that have neither taken physical form nor swallowed bait. They are said to bestow blessings upon those accepted by the Fontemer as well as those that are able to control it. Of course, those that have a deeper understanding of natural philosophy would discount such groundless speculation.

26152101.desc: A crab that makes its home in borrowed shells.\nIt seems not to have any of the aggressiveness possessed by many wild animals. Perhaps it is because animals who attack for purposes other than obtaining food possess some degree of territoriality, yet the territory of the Armored Crab is naught but the small home upon its back.

26152201.desc: A crab that makes its home in borrowed shells.\nIt seems not to have any of the aggressiveness possessed by many wild animals. Perhaps it is because animals who attack for purposes other than obtaining food possess some degree of territoriality, yet the territory of the Armored Crab is naught but the small home upon its back.

26153101.desc: A type of mammal that resides in the watery regions of Fontaine. It communicates with its companions through melodious sounds.\nDue to its density, water is a much more efficient medium of sound than air. Drawing inspiration from the Blubberbeast, someone from the Research Institute invented a type of technology that converted images into data to facilitate instant transmission. But due to the technical limitations of the experiment, it never became widely adopted outside the Institute.\nIn reality, however, data transmission technology based on fluid and sound has existed since ancient times. As the saying goes, there's nothing new under the sun.

26154101.desc: An aquatic creature that hunts by firing watery projectiles.\nAlthough it looks like a hat, it actually eats from its underside, so attempting to wear it is strongly disadvised. In the words of someone who once did this: "That wasn't very clever, was it?"

26154201.desc: An aquatic creature that hunts by firing watery projectiles.\nAlthough it looks like a hat, it actually eats from its underside, so attempting to wear it is strongly disadvised. In the words of someone who once did this: "That wasn't very clever, was it?"

26155101.desc: An aquatic creature that hunts by firing watery projectiles.\nAmong the (admittedly somewhat sparse) ranks of Fontemer Aberrant enthusiasts, Bubbly Seahorses have many fans. As with clockwork meka enthusiasts, a small minority of Fontemer Aberrant enthusiasts can be very standoffish when it comes to people whose opinions differ from their own.

26155201.desc: An aquatic creature that hunts by firing watery projectiles.\nAmong the (admittedly somewhat sparse) ranks of Fontemer Aberrant enthusiasts, Bubbly Seahorses have many fans. As with clockwork meka enthusiasts, a small minority of Fontemer Aberrant enthusiasts can be very standoffish when it comes to people whose opinions differ from their own.

26155301.desc: An aquatic creature that hunts by firing watery projectiles.\nAmong the (admittedly somewhat sparse) ranks of Fontemer Aberrant enthusiasts, Bubbly Seahorses have many fans. As with clockwork meka enthusiasts, a small minority of Fontemer Aberrant enthusiasts can be very standoffish when it comes to people whose opinions differ from their own.

26156101.desc: An aquatic creature that hunts by firing watery projectiles.\nThe ability to fire water bombs is of course not uncommon among Fontemer Aberrants. But for your average careless diver, most of whom are tourists, a high-pressure water current of this kind can pose a significant threat. The thickness of diving equipment is therefore necessary for two reasons — firstly, to resist the pressure of the water itself, but secondly, to protect against the attacks of Fontemer Aberrants.

26156201.desc: An aquatic creature that hunts by firing watery projectiles.\nThe ability to fire water bombs is of course not uncommon among Fontemer Aberrants. But for your average careless diver, most of whom are tourists, a high-pressure water current of this kind can pose a significant threat. The thickness of diving equipment is therefore necessary for two reasons — firstly, to resist the pressure of the water itself, but secondly, to protect against the attacks of Fontemer Aberrants.

26157101.desc: An aquatic creature that hunts by firing watery projectiles.\nFrom an evolutionary perspective, it is assumed that Fontemer Aberrants have developed from aquatic creatures due to environmental factors specific to Fontaine. As such, it can be inferred that at some point in the past, Fontaine's original aquatic lifeforms differed little from those native to the other regions of Teyvat.
26157101.ja: アンジェリックアプリシア

26157201.desc: An aquatic creature that hunts by firing watery projectiles.\nFrom an evolutionary perspective, it is assumed that Fontemer Aberrants have developed from aquatic creatures due to environmental factors specific to Fontaine. As such, it can be inferred that at some point in the past, Fontaine's original aquatic lifeforms differed little from those native to the other regions of Teyvat.
26157201.ja: アンジェリックアプリシア

26160101.desc: A crab that makes its home in borrowed shells.\nArmored Crabs are constantly searching for shells that fit their bodies as they grow. A storybook that told the tale of the trials of an Armored Crab searching for a suitable shell was extremely popular in Fontaine for a time. Though the story is filled with childlike wonder, the reaction after proved that, like many fairytales, it touched adults even more deeply.

26160201.desc: The adult form of an Angelic Sea Hare. The "wings" on its back are actually fat used for storing elemental energy.\nThis type of sea creature spends its whole life eating and conserving energy far beyond its actual requirements. Perhaps if the oceans dry out some day, they will be able to continue to survive — or simply become an important source of nutrition for other creatures...
26160201.ja: チェルビックアプリシア

26160301.desc: The adult form of a male Bubbly Seahorse. It is extremely aggressive.\nSome people even claim to have encountered the king among the seahorses. It is said that they are proud beings with four long limbs.
26160301.ja: アワアワタツノコ·オス

26160302.desc: One of the two sovereigns who once stood at the apex of the aberrant species of the Fontemer, and the subject of many a tale among sailors.\nAn Armored Crab that avoids predation, and can keep hunting and eating, will continue to grow, continually seeking out suitable shells to become its new armor. But eventually, it became simply too gargantuan. Before the first diluvian period, a massive Armored Crab once attacked a ship, and was finally forced back into the depths by Basil Elton, who had not yet been reinstated as a naval commander.\nImagine this world: All of humanity has been purged from Teyvat, and the ever-growing Emperor of Fire and Iron eventually wears the Palais Mermonia upon its body like a luxurious coat of white stone. Of course, in such a world, there naturally would be no one to call it, half-jokingly and half in awe, the "Emperor of Fire and Iron."

26180101.desc:
One of the two sovereigns standing at the apex of the Fontemer Aberrants.
Poets and authors often proclaim it to be proud and noble due to its solitary tendencies, but the true reason behind such adulatory descriptions is its elegant and slender body. As such, it is a "Pearl Seahorse," while the suzerain of the Armored Crabs is an "Emperor."
In the legends and rumors of Fontaine, a brutal war was once waged among the Aberrants of the Fontemer, leaving only the "Millennial Pearl Seahorse" and "Emperor of Fire and Iron" splitting the great lake into two courts, one ruling over the north, the other the south. In the "Song of Dobharcu," the writer describes the outcome of the war: the great Hunter's Ray known as the Stormlord stirred huge waves in its death throes, causing what is now known by the people as the "first diluvian period"...
Of course, all of this is nothing more than the romantic imaginations of people who are unwilling to accept the bland realities of the world. For the Fontemer Aberrants are in fact just simple aquatic animals, and they have no grand courts nor fallen kingdoms, nor do they possess words meant to exalt or curse.

26190101.desc:
These elegant and proud mystical beasts only live in mountains shrouded in adeptal energy.
Since ancient times, they have been considered a symbol of good fortune, and their preference for living aloof from the material world has been admired by intellectuals for generations. In ancient legends from Chenyu Vale, the leader of the suanni was called the Mountain Lord and was considered to be of the same standing as the adepti.
Another theory claims that the Xuanwen Beasts that roam the mountains these days are the descendants of the suanni, but that the thinning of their blood over the years has caused them to devolve into violent creatures. Although this contradicts another theory regarding the origin of Xuanwen Beasts, the few records of the suanni often show them attended by a large number of Xuanwen Beasts.
These days, the well-known Wushou Dance in Chenyu Vale came from the movements of the suanni. But since only a handful of people have actually seen such creatures, most can only imagine what they look like. After thousands of years of changes and different artistic interpretations, the Wushou Dance costume head has developed into its current style.

26190201.desc: Xuanwen Beasts, named for the dark patterns on their bodies, are fierce creatures that inhabit the mountains of Chenyu Vale.\nIn the region's folklore, these beasts were the servants of an adeptus in ancient times, tasked with vanquishing evil and protecting the region. However, they devolved into brutal creatures after said adeptus passed away. These legends cannot be verified, and no one knows the true identity of this adeptus. This much is for sure, however — one should stay away from these aggressive creatures for one's safety.\nFor over a thousand years, these beasts have lost a tremendous amount of territory that once belonged to them to relentless human encroachment. These days, they can only occasionally be spotted in the remote mountains of Chenyu Vale...

26200101.desc: A young Tepetlisaurus with the ability to tunnel between rocks and solid phlogiston.\nThey have not yet formed the horns on their forehead, and their digging skills are still developing as well. It is even common to hear about young Tepetlisaurs getting trapped by rocks while practicing their digging. However, one day, they will grow into a form that may travel freely through even the toughest of soils.

26200201.desc: A Saurian with a drill-like horn and strong claws that can tunnel through rocks and solid phlogiston.\nAccording to legend, the ancestor of all Tepetlisaurs was a massive drake as large as a mountain, with an exceptionally long lifespan. When it slept, mountains would form along its back, and when it woke, it would shake off the dirt and rocks, leaving behind gems and jade shining amongst its scales. The huge, drill-shaped objects in the Children of Echoes are said to be the remains of that great drake's large drill-horn.

26210101.desc: A young Koholasaurus with the ability to swim through water and liquid phlogiston.\nTheir skin and flippers are still soft and tender, to the point that they can't even tolerate hot environments for long periods like adults. However, one day, they will grow into the form that can swim freely through the water.

26210201.desc: A Saurian with thick, strong flippers and a long tail that can swim in water and liquid phlogiston.\nAccording to legend, more ancient dragons were even more able to adapt to their environments, and when the largest dragon in the ocean of the age floated on the surface, it could even be mistaken for an island. It is said that today's Koholasaurus are the descendants of that great sea dragon, and in their broad backs the colossal forms of those ancient sea beasts may yet be glimpsed.

26220101.desc: A young Yumkasaurus with the ability to spit Flamegranate pectin hidden in their cheek pouches out, wrapping around distant objects.\nTheir hold on pectin-coated objects isn't strong enough, nor is their sense of balance good enough to allow them to move freely through the air. Sometimes, they'll even fall over to one side just sitting on their tails. However, one day, they will grow into the form that can swing freely between the trees without a care.

26220201.desc: A Saurian with powerful hind legs and a fluffy tail, capable of spitting Flamegranate pectin hidden in their cheek pouches out, wrapping around distant objects.\nAccording to legend, the original Yumkasaurs were not at all like today, but much smaller, so small that they were difficult even to see. They could roam freely with the wind, cling to the bodies of the massive dragons, or gather in groups to move about like clouds. However, in order to maintain their form after their abilities degenerated, they had no choice but to assume their current shape.

26220301.desc: A powerful Yumkasaur that has survived both the ravages of time and countless battles, surviving until the present day.\nThis "Mountain King," who once joined forces with the great heroes against the Black Tide, holds a special place in the hearts of the Scions of the Canopy. Some tribe members believe that it has its current body shape because it has a unique physique, like the Qucusaurus "Tyrant"... Though in fact, this is simply because it's lived for so long, and eaten way, WAY too much.
26220301.ja: 山の王·貪食のユムカ竜

26230101.desc: A young Qucusaur with a light, agile body.\nIts neck and wings have yet to fully develop, and it still has a long way to go before it can wield gaseous phlogiston. There are stories of older Qucusaurs pushing younglings off cliffs to encourage them to fly. While the truth of such tales is uncertain, as long as it keeps practicing day and night, there can be no doubt that the soft-feathered fledgling will eventually grow strong and resilient.

26230201.desc: A Saurian with large, supple wings that can glide through the air for long periods.\nIt is said that the ancestors of the Qucusaurs were the closest in form to the mighty winged dragons, and that they could soar through the sky like clouds. According to the storytellers, when the greatest of such dragons spread its wings, the entire sky would be blotted out. Of course, the Qucusaurs we see today no longer possess such forms, but the claws they hide within their downy feather coats remain as sharp as ever.

26230301.desc: A Qucusaurus whose body has attained a supernatural form due to enduring forces that the bodies of modern Saurians cannot control.\nLegends say that when the giant Qucusaur who now often dwells in the mountain fog was young, he also once followed the heroes who saved Natlan in their adventures. It is said that one of those heroes once agreed to make the pilgrimage with him together to the volcano, to save his mind back from the brink of insanity that the increasing violent power in his blood was forcing him towards. However, judging from his current title of "Tyrant," that story did not have a happy ending.

26240101.desc: A young Iktomisaur with a keen sense of perception.\nIt has yet to grow its full plumage and may even appear a little slow on the uptake. It is said that among the Saurians that now live, Iktomisaurs not only have the longest lifespans, but spend the longest time as juveniles too. They possess the capacity to communicate with the Night Kingdom or Wayob, though it may take many years before the young Saurians can fully comprehend this.

26240201.desc: Able to use their plumage for leaping, Iktomisaurs are also the only type of Saurian to have grasped how to enter the "Spiritspeaker" state.\nAccording to legend, their ancestors did not have a physical form, and instead could drift like spirits between reality and the spiritual realm, manifesting themselves through the darkness of night. Some also say that the first Iktomisaur to emerge from the Night Kingdom was not actually a true Saurian, but rather a unique race distinct from ordinary Saurians.

26250101.desc: A young Tatankasaurus that has not yet mastered full control of its powerful frame, leaving its movements clumsy.\nIts second set of horns are still growing out, and its back and snout are not quite strong enough to smash through rocks that block the road. Given the time to grow, it will one day be able to roam freely across the fertile plains.

26250201.desc: A saurian with a hard, bony crest and a powerful body suited to dashing around volcanic landscapes.\nAccording to legend, the Tatankasaurus's ancestors were so large they could use their horns to move mountains, but they lacked the agility of their smaller, modern relatives. Perhaps the great power that Tatankasaurs still possess is a gift passed down through their bloodline.

26260101.desc: The Children of Echoes believe in and worship the Wayob, which manifests upon the land with the power of totems and Nightsouls.\nThe people of Natlan believe that the Wayob dwell in the kingdom of the Lord of the Night, and have no fixed form, instead attaching themselves to anything in order to provide guidance to lost tribespeople. Wayob manifestations are particularly special, and the figure revealed through the totems often has an important purpose.\nThe Children of Echoes believe that their Wayob has the power to shape mountains and valleys, and can control the echoes created when rock meets stone.

26260201.desc: The People of the Springs believe in and worship the Wayob, which manifests upon the land with the power of totems and Nightsouls.\nThe so-called "Wayob" is the belief that gradually formed primarily from the tribes and obsidian totems after the people of Natlan began communicating with the kingdom of the Lord of the Night. A "Wayob" is a consciousness of collective thought, and the home of the ancestors' souls.\nThe People of the Springs believe their Wayob has the power to control the tides and waves, and can control the changes of flowing and still, dead waters alike.

26260301.desc: The Scions of the Canopy believe in and worship the Wayob, which manifests upon the land with the power of totems and Nightsouls.\nIn the stories of the storytellers, Wayob manifestations often appear as the messengers of trials, or guides to the kingdom of the Lord of the Night. A Saurian-Crowned Warrior once said that he fought with a Wayob in a trance while practicing his skills, and in doing so, gained deeper understanding.\nThe Scions of the Canopy believe their Wayob has the power to control the growth of fruits and leaves, and can also control the roots of crops and draw the patterns of the veins of leaves.

26260801.desc: The Masters of the Night-Wind believe in and worship the Wayob, which manifests upon the land with the power of totems and Nightsouls.\nThe Masters of the Night-Wind have tried using many mediums to communicate with the Night Kingdom. Eventually, they discovered that the medium that allowed them to establish the most stable connection with the Wayob was obsidian. This may explain why, over the ages, Wayob Manifestations have taken on a form that resembles a stone statue. The Masters of the Night-Wind believe their Wayob has the power to control the process of freezing and crystallization, and can also command both fixedness and mutability.

26260901.desc: The Flower-Feather Clan believe in and worship the Wayob, which manifests upon the land with the power of totems and Nightsouls.\nThey say that long ago, Wayob Manifestations looked very different from how they do today, taking on a rougher form that was more akin to that of an obsidian statue. But once their outline had been recorded in woven scrolls, there have been few changes in their appearance since.\nThe people of the Flower-Feather Clan believe their Wayob has the power to control fire and burning flames, and can also control the flow of heat and blazing winds.

26261101.desc: The Collective of Plenty believe in and worship the Wayob, which manifests upon the land with the power of totems and Nightsouls.\nAccording to tribal legend, the Wayob has taken on countless forms. In the dim, pre-dawn darkness, where faces were hidden in shadows, the Wayob would wrestle with the mightiest tribal warriors, with neither side prevailing. The Collective of Plenty believe their Wayob has the power to control thunder and speed, and can bestow abundant harvests upon the land.

26270101.desc: A strange monster that must continually absorb heat to stay in an active state.\nOnce, a more ancient and deep fire burned across all of Natlan in myriad forms. At that time, the once-great primitive residents used these fires to transmit light, heat, and wisdom. They believed that life and the soul too took their initial shape from the sparks that flew when flint was struck.\nIf it possesses an eternally burning core, then even a stubborn stone can bring about life. The embers within the body of the Avatar of Lava seem to be the cold, ash-like remnants of that ancient era.

26270201.desc: A strange monster that must continually absorb heat to stay in an active state.\nThe ancient civilization used many different types of golden designs to drive the flow of phlogiston, allowing massive constructs and magnificent cities to operate under the wisdom of the golden patterns. It is said that in addition to machines with fixed structures, the creatures known as Avatars of Lava are actually badly damaged lifeforms that were once created in the same way. However, after the flames of the sacred mountain were extinguished, most of them lost their sense of purpose and direction.

26270301.desc: A monster that can continuously generate heat to sustain its activities.\nLegends say these monsters with lava at their cores are the products of a distinct line of research to the Source Mechanisms that followed them — research into whether the primal flame could be used to create a new race based on humans. This research undoubtedly failed, for once the reaver arrived with their throne from beyond the skies, all that the primal flame could birth were hollow shells whose nominal lifeforce granted them no more consciousness than a stone.

26290101.desc: An ancient variant of mountain weasel that has adapted to a unique, Phlogiston-rich environment isolated from the outside world.\nBy consuming creatures rich in Phlogiston, this species accumulates power in the shell it holds. After a prolonged existence in the ruins of the Sacred Mountain, its affinity for Phlogiston seems to have caused it to be influenced by the Source Mechanisms within the ruins, creating a unique symbiotic relationship between them.

26300101.desc: A beast that has undergone a unique evolution due to age-long immersion in the ancient moon's power.\nStrange lightning once fell upon the land blessed by moonlight, causing once ordinary antelopes to gain the power to wield lightning. They say that some have seen a truly strange sight — antelopes standing on cliffs at the convergence of a storm, attracting bolts of lightning to temper their bodies.

26300201.desc: A beast that has undergone a unique evolution due to age-long immersion in the ancient moon's power.\nIt is said that in the ancient past, when these borderlands were still shrouded by the pitch-dark shadow, only the charging of the giant rhinos could return the power that makes all things turn... And this was all that was asked of them in return for the moonlight shining down its blessings.
26300201.ja: 集光のブレイドライノ

26300301.desc: A beast that has undergone a unique evolution due to age-long immersion in the ancient moon's power.\nLegend has it that when the waves of calamity rolled over the land, even those animals who dwelled in the Forsaken Sea were not spared. Those who could not accept the moonlight into themselves vanished like foam, whether great sea serpents who could send waves skyward, or single-eyed monsters who once plotted to consume all things.

26300401.desc: A beast that has undergone a unique evolution due to age-long immersion in the ancient moon's power.\nLegend has it that when a dark calamity wiped out countless lives, the frontier forests fell completely silent. In that stillness, the only sound to break the dead quiet was the howl of the Glacial Wolves calling to the moon. Night after night, their mournful cries echoed across the empty wilderness in the cold moonlight.

26301101.desc: The moon's ancient power has seeped into these illusory wings, and the butterfly-shaped monster now dances lightly in the moonlight.\nThe principles of evolution state that after the wild yet primeval power was tamed by the heavenly ruler, such a monster should not be able to maintain its shape, becoming smaller and weaker over time. However, the moon's blessing has allowed it to glide through this world while remaining in its prime, displaying the remnants of an older world, when the ancient moon once illuminated the land.

26302101.desc: An ancient monster drawn to moonlight, this gecko dwells deep within layers of rock.\nThe gradual accumulation of kuuvahki has crystallized its body into segments as precise as mechanical components. These parts can harden and form stone spikes used to repel intruders.\nSome scholars believe this unusual lizard's ancestors once roamed the surface. Over the ages, sweeping changes in the world drove them underground, where they have since lived in darkness for countless generations. Though their memory of true moonlight has faded, instinct remains. On nights of the full moon, they are compelled to gnaw on rock and soil suffused with lunar radiance to preserve their bloodline.

26310101.desc:
A product of Bio-Alchemy, which was once prevalent across the frozen tundra — a hybrid crafted monster.
If a four-legged beast possessed a carapace and horn like an Onikabuto, it might just serve as a shock troop to break through enemy ranks.
Logically, crafted monsters that pursue a single function rarely survive in the natural world. Most would perish for violating the laws of nature once they lose their designated battlefield, but clearly, the Helm-Armored Beast is an exception.
Nowadays, on the frozen tundra of Snezhnaya, one can often see Helm-Armored Beasts hunting in packs.

26310201.desc:
A product of Bio-Alchemy once prevalent across the frozen tundra, the heterogeneous crafted magical beast.
If monsters that travel through earth, Cryo, and snow possessed the vision to see everything clearly in the shadows, would they become even more formidable predators?
The results of the experiment were an extraordinary Success. These Burrowing Beasts shuttle beneath the surface at night, digging traps in the dark or hiding in the shadows to hunt.
According to a report in the Pioneers Herald, workers living in Rainbow Cryo Town once saw a giant Burrowing Beast almost as tall as two people... but that is probably None other than nonsense.

26310301.desc: A product of Bio-Alchemy once prevalent upon the frozen earth, a cross-species crafted magical beast.\nWinged short-legged elephants could presumably migrate without geographical restrictions, while also satisfying the need to pluck fruits from higher places.\nSolely for this purpose, the creator crafted such a magical beast. In the subsequent war against the Onslaught of Dark Beasts, the Chimeric Winged Elephant conducted intelligence work together with the Vila, ensuring the unimpeded flow of military orders during the Belyi Tsar's advance.

26310401.desc:
A product of Bio-Alchemy, a Crafted magical beast that took shape in a highly unusual manner.
Instead of following artificial designs, this Crafted monster was formed through the self-assembly of life Segments, which even granted it the mystical trait of being able to freely Use the power of the Elements.
Even when life is shattered to the point where almost nothing but Segments remain, is there still some will and mighty power that compels them to Grow according to a mysterious plan?
Today, perhaps None know the answer to this anymore.

26310501.desc:
A product of Bio-Alchemy, it is one of the abandoned crafted magical beasts.
To realize one of their great wishes, a master of Alchemy used an indescribable technique to create numerous primordial forms known as "Prototypes."
Among them, only one achieved success and managed to grow into the perfect creation as planned, while the other primordial forms that were close to perfect but ultimately failed were casually crafted into various two-headed magical beasts.
Although regarded as failures, the power possessed by these special two-headed magical beasts is still immense. Within the category of crafted magical beasts, there are none that can rival them.
26310501.ja: キメラ・フリューゲルレーヴェJP0B

28010101.desc: A claw-snapping crab that can be found in various water bodies throughout Teyvat.\nThis golden-shelled crab is especially tasty, and is the star of the show in the famed Liyue dish known as Golden Crab.\nSome people call those who run amok as they please "crabs," but a crab's manner of movement is not so much a matter of their character as it is their physical makeup. Such monikers are most unfair to crab-kind.

28010102.desc: A claw-snapping crab that can be found in various water bodies throughout Teyvat.\nThe shells of these crabs are painted in many beautiful red shades, which wonderfully reflect the many stages of sunlight. They look especially good cooked.

28010103.desc: A claw-snapping crab that can be found in various water bodies throughout Teyvat.\nThese crabs have blue-gray shells and are more docile and less prone to anger than other crab species. Their limbs, however, are of greater strength. Getting pinched by one of their claws is definitely going to hurt.

28010104.desc: A claw-snapping crab that can be found in various water bodies throughout Teyvat.\nIt has a purple shell that resembles the emblem of the Shogunate. It also is also quite Shogun-like in its fearless, dominant movements. Such arrogance! Such impertinence!

28010105.desc: A claw-snapping crab that can be found in various water bodies throughout Teyvat.\nIt has a light red colored shell and a gentle nature. As such, it's a lot more suitable to be raised for ornamental display than others of its kind.

28010201.desc:
A small lizard with horns on its head that can often be found in shadowy bushes.
These lizards have beautiful blue scales and will break their tails off to escape when caught.
Lizard tails have special medicinal properties when dried and ground down into a powder. Some crazy alchemists have even found a way to process them into catalysts for explosions.
Once they are separated from the body, these tails will lose their vitality and curl up. They will, for reasons unknown, also turn bright green.

28010202.desc:
A small lizard with horns on its head that can often be found in shadowy bushes.
These lizards have pretty red scales and will detach their tails to escape when caught.
Lizard tails have special medicinal properties when dried and ground down into a powder. Some crazy alchemists have even found a way to process them into catalysts for explosions.
Once they are separated from the body, these tails will lose their vitality and curl up. They will, for reasons unknown, also turn bright green.

28010203.desc:
A small lizard with horns on its head that can often be found in shadowy bushes.
These lizards have lovely green scales and will discard their tails to escape when caught.
